AI BIJAN Motion - packed source files of this folder. Do not edit by hand.
The skill upload in the Claude app accepts at most 200 files, so the source files are packed here.
`node <skill folder>/new-project.mjs <project folder> --kit=<style>` unpacks them into the project.
Format: per file one line with four '=' signs, the byte length and the path, then exactly that many bytes.

==== 6188 src/kits/voxelverse/camera/Post.tsx
// Camera + finishing. The rig applies the camera state for this frame before R3F advances, then a
// composer renders: scene → ground-truth AO → depth of field → restrained bloom →
// tone mapping → grade (vignette, black lift, grain). AO and DoF read depth from
// layer 0 only, so rain, halos and light cones never confuse them.

import React, { useLayoutEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import { useFrame, useThree } from "@react-three/fiber";
import { HalfFloatType, PerspectiveCamera, Vector2, WebGLRenderTarget } from "three";
import { EffectComposer } from "three/examples/jsm/postprocessing/EffectComposer.js";
import { RenderPass } from "three/examples/jsm/postprocessing/RenderPass.js";
import { GTAOPass } from "three/examples/jsm/postprocessing/GTAOPass.js";
import { BokehPass } from "three/examples/jsm/postprocessing/BokehPass.js";
import { UnrealBloomPass } from "three/examples/jsm/postprocessing/UnrealBloomPass.js";
import { OutputPass } from "three/examples/jsm/postprocessing/OutputPass.js";
import { ShaderPass } from "three/examples/jsm/postprocessing/ShaderPass.js";
import type { CamState } from "./rig";
import { FX_LAYER } from "../lib/layers";

export const CameraRig: React.FC<{ cam: CamState }> = ({ cam: c }) => {
  const { camera, gl } = useThree();
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const cam = camera as PerspectiveCamera;
    cam.position.set(...c.pos);
    cam.lookAt(...c.at);
    cam.fov = c.fov;
    cam.near = 0.03;
    cam.far = 600;
    cam.layers.enable(FX_LAYER);
    cam.updateProjectionMatrix();
    cam.updateMatrixWorld();
    gl.toneMappingExposure = c.exposure;
  }, [c, camera, gl]);
  return null;
};

const GradeShader = {
  uniforms: {
    tDiffuse: { value: null },
    uTime: { value: 0 },
    uVignette: { value: 0.32 },
    uLift: { value: 0.022 },
    uGrain: { value: 0.035 },
    uRes: { value: new Vector2(1080, 1920) },
  },
  vertexShader: /* glsl */ `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: /* glsl */ `
    uniform sampler2D tDiffuse; uniform float uTime; uniform float uVignette; uniform float uLift; uniform float uGrain; uniform vec2 uRes;
    varying vec2 vUv;
    float hash(vec2 p){ p = fract(p * vec2(443.897, 441.423)); p += dot(p, p.yx + 19.19); return fract((p.x + p.y) * p.x); }
    void main(){
      vec4 c = texture2D(tDiffuse, vUv);
      // gentle split-tone: teal in the shadows, warmth in the highlights
      float l = dot(c.rgb, vec3(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722));
      c.rgb += (1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.45, l)) * vec3(-0.006, 0.006, 0.008);
      c.rgb += smoothstep(0.55, 1.0, l) * vec3(0.012, 0.004, -0.01);
      // lift the floor so shadows stay readable on a phone
      c.rgb = uLift + c.rgb * (1.0 - uLift);
      // vignette (elliptical for 9:16)
      vec2 d = (vUv - 0.5) * vec2(1.0, 1.35);
      c.rgb *= 1.0 - uVignette * smoothstep(0.25, 0.85, length(d));
      // film grain, seeded by the frame (deterministic)
      float g = hash(vUv * uRes + uTime * 17.0) - 0.5;
      c.rgb += g * uGrain * (0.6 + 0.4 * (1.0 - l));
      gl_FragColor = c;
    }`,
};

/** Replaces NaN/Inf (half-float overflow) before blur-based passes can spread it. */
const SanitizeShader = {
  uniforms: { tDiffuse: { value: null } },
  vertexShader: /* glsl */ `varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: /* glsl */ `
    uniform sampler2D tDiffuse; varying vec2 vUv;
    void main(){
      vec4 c = texture2D(tDiffuse, vUv);
      if (any(isnan(c)) || any(isinf(c))) c = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
      gl_FragColor = vec4(clamp(c.rgb, 0.0, 48.0), 1.0);
    }`,
};

/** `frame` seeds the grain; `mask` lists the passes to run (drop "ao" or "dof" to isolate a problem). */
export const Post: React.FC<{ cam: CamState; frame: number; mask?: string }> = ({ cam, frame, mask = "ao,sanitize,dof,bloom,grade" }) => {
  const { gl, scene, camera, size } = useThree();
  const chain = useMemo(() => {
    const w = size.width, h = size.height;
    const rt = new WebGLRenderTarget(w, h, { type: HalfFloatType, samples: 4 });
    const composer = new EffectComposer(gl, rt);
    composer.setPixelRatio(1);
    composer.setSize(w, h);
    const render = new RenderPass(scene, camera);
    const ao = new GTAOPass(scene, camera, w, h);
    ao.blendIntensity = 0.85;
    ao.updateGtaoMaterial({ radius: 0.35, distanceExponent: 1.4, thickness: 1.0, scale: 1.0, samples: 12, distanceFallOff: 1.0, screenSpaceRadius: false });
    ao.updatePdMaterial({ lumaPhi: 10, depthPhi: 2, normalPhi: 3, radius: 6, rings: 2, samples: 12 });
    const dof = new BokehPass(scene, camera, { focus: 3, aperture: 0.002, maxblur: 0.009 });
    const bloom = new UnrealBloomPass(new Vector2(w, h), 0.32, 0.55, 0.92);
    const output = new OutputPass();
    const grade = new ShaderPass(GradeShader);
    grade.uniforms.uRes.value.set(w, h);
    // depth-reading passes see layer 0 only
    for (const p of [ao, dof]) {
      const orig = p.render.bind(p);
      p.render = (...args: Parameters<typeof orig>) => {
        const mask = camera.layers.mask;
        camera.layers.disable(FX_LAYER);
        orig(...args);
        camera.layers.mask = mask;
      };
    }
    const on = (k: string) => mask.split(",").includes(k);
    composer.addPass(render);
    if (on("ao")) composer.addPass(ao);
    if (on("sanitize")) composer.addPass(new ShaderPass(SanitizeShader));
    if (on("dof")) composer.addPass(dof);
    if (on("bloom")) composer.addPass(bloom);
    composer.addPass(output);
    if (on("grade")) composer.addPass(grade);
    return { composer, dof, grade, bloom };
  }, [gl, scene, camera, size.width, size.height, mask]);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const u = chain.dof.uniforms as unknown as Record<string, { value: number }>;
    u.focus.value = cam.focusDist;
    u.aperture.value = cam.aperture;
    u.maxblur.value = cam.maxBlur;
    chain.grade.uniforms.uTime.value = Math.floor(frame) % 997;
  }, [frame, chain, cam]);

  // priority 1: we own the render
  useFrame(() => {
    chain.composer.render();
  }, 1);
  return null;
};

==== 3439 src/kits/voxelverse/camera/rig.ts
// Camera language for VOXELVERSE films. A film is a list of shots; each shot is a list of timed keys
// (position, aim, lens). Between keys the move is a time-based Hermite spline with Catmull-Rom tangents,
// so speed carries through a key instead of stopping; the shot's first and last keys ease in and out.
// Focus is a world point per frame. `cameraAt(shots, f)` is pure: any frame renders alone.
// Frames here are film frames on a 60 fps clock (pass `frame / fps * 60`).

import { fbm1 } from "../core/noise";
import type { V3 } from "../lib/voxel";

export type CamKey = {
  f: number;
  pos: V3;
  at: V3;
  /** vertical field of view, degrees */
  fov: number;
};

export type Shot = {
  name: string;
  from: number;
  to: number;
  keys: CamKey[];
  /** what the lens focuses on (world point), as a function of frame */
  focus: (f: number) => V3;
  /** bokeh strength: blur per unit of depth away from the focus plane */
  aperture: number | ((f: number) => number);
  /** largest blur radius, as a fraction of the frame */
  maxBlur?: number;
  /** exposure multiplier (1 = neutral) */
  exposure: number;
  /** exponential fog density for this shot (thicker at street level, thinner for wides) */
  fog: number;
  /** handheld drift amplitude on the aim point (fraction of the aim distance) */
  handheld?: number;
};

export type CamState = { pos: V3; at: V3; fov: number; focusDist: number; aperture: number; maxBlur: number; exposure: number; fog: number; shot: Shot };

/** Hermite interpolation of a scalar sampled at key times, Catmull-Rom tangents, eased ends. */
const herm = (f: number, ts: number[], vs: number[]) => {
  const n = ts.length;
  if (f <= ts[0]) return vs[0];
  if (f >= ts[n - 1]) return vs[n - 1];
  let i = 0;
  while (f > ts[i + 1]) i++;
  const t0 = ts[i], t1 = ts[i + 1];
  const h = t1 - t0;
  const u = (f - t0) / h;
  const m = (k: number) => (k === 0 || k === n - 1 ? 0 : (vs[k + 1] - vs[k - 1]) / (ts[k + 1] - ts[k - 1]));
  const m0 = m(i) * h, m1 = m(i + 1) * h;
  const u2 = u * u, u3 = u2 * u;
  return (2 * u3 - 3 * u2 + 1) * vs[i] + (u3 - 2 * u2 + u) * m0 + (-2 * u3 + 3 * u2) * vs[i + 1] + (u3 - u2) * m1;
};

export const shotAt = (shots: Shot[], f: number) => shots.find((sh) => f >= sh.from && f < sh.to) ?? shots[shots.length - 1];

export const cameraAt = (shots: Shot[], f: number): CamState => {
  const sh = shotAt(shots, f);
  const ts = sh.keys.map((k) => k.f);
  const comp = (sel: (k: CamKey) => number) => herm(f, ts, sh.keys.map(sel));
  const pos: V3 = [comp((k) => k.pos[0]), comp((k) => k.pos[1]), comp((k) => k.pos[2])];
  const at: V3 = [comp((k) => k.at[0]), comp((k) => k.at[1]), comp((k) => k.at[2])];
  const hh = sh.handheld ?? 0;
  if (hh) {
    // operator drift: slow, low-amplitude, never a loop
    const d = Math.hypot(at[0] - pos[0], at[1] - pos[1], at[2] - pos[2]);
    at[0] += fbm1(f / 70, 11) * hh * d;
    at[1] += fbm1(f / 80, 12) * hh * d * 0.7;
  }
  const fv = sh.focus(f);
  const dir = [at[0] - pos[0], at[1] - pos[1], at[2] - pos[2]];
  const dl = Math.hypot(dir[0], dir[1], dir[2]);
  const focusDist = Math.max(0.1, ((fv[0] - pos[0]) * dir[0] + (fv[1] - pos[1]) * dir[1] + (fv[2] - pos[2]) * dir[2]) / dl);
  const aperture = typeof sh.aperture === "number" ? sh.aperture : sh.aperture(f);
  return { pos, at, fov: comp((k) => k.fov), focusDist, aperture, maxBlur: sh.maxBlur ?? 0.01, exposure: sh.exposure, fog: sh.fog, shot: sh };
};

==== 3379 src/kits/voxelverse/core/motion.ts
// Deterministic motion primitives. Every function is a pure function of the frame,
// so any frame can be rendered in isolation and in any order.

export type Ease = (t: number) => number;

export const clamp = (v: number, a = 0, b = 1) => Math.min(b, Math.max(a, v));
export const lerp = (a: number, b: number, t: number) => a + (b - a) * t;
export const invLerp = (a: number, b: number, v: number) => clamp((v - a) / (b - a));
export const remap = (v: number, a: number, b: number, c: number, d: number, ease: Ease = linear) =>
  lerp(c, d, ease(invLerp(a, b, v)));

export const linear: Ease = (t) => t;

// Curves are named by intent so scenes read like direction notes.
export const ease = {
  linear,
  // Camera: long, heavy, no visible start or stop.
  camera: (t: number) => (t < 0.5 ? 16 * t ** 5 : 1 - (-2 * t + 2) ** 5 / 2),
  cameraSoft: (t: number) => (t < 0.5 ? 4 * t ** 3 : 1 - (-2 * t + 2) ** 3 / 2),
  // Arrivals: fast in, long settle.
  arrive: (t: number) => (t === 1 ? 1 : 1 - 2 ** (-10 * t)),
  arriveSoft: (t: number) => 1 - (1 - t) ** 3,
  // Departures: slow start, accelerating exit.
  depart: (t: number) => (t === 0 ? 0 : 2 ** (10 * t - 10)),
  departSoft: (t: number) => t ** 3,
  // Mechanical lock with a small overshoot.
  lock: (t: number) => {
    const c1 = 1.4;
    const c3 = c1 + 1;
    return 1 + c3 * (t - 1) ** 3 + c1 * (t - 1) ** 2;
  },
  // Organic in-out for body motion.
  body: (t: number) => -(Math.cos(Math.PI * t) - 1) / 2,
  // Snappy anticipation: dips below 0 before going.
  anticipate: (t: number) => {
    const c = 1.7;
    return t * t * ((c + 1) * t - c);
  },
  smooth: (t: number) => t * t * (3 - 2 * t),
} satisfies Record<string, Ease>;

/** 0→1 progress between two frames with an easing curve. */
export const ramp = (frame: number, from: number, to: number, e: Ease = linear) =>
  e(invLerp(from, to, frame));

export type Key = { f: number; v: number; e?: Ease };

/** Piecewise keyframes; each key's easing shapes the segment that ends on it. */
export const keys = (frame: number, ks: Key[]): number => {
  if (frame <= ks[0].f) return ks[0].v;
  for (let i = 1; i < ks.length; i++) {
    const a = ks[i - 1];
    const b = ks[i];
    if (frame <= b.f) {
      const t = (frame - a.f) / (b.f - a.f);
      return lerp(a.v, b.v, (b.e ?? ease.body)(t));
    }
  }
  return ks[ks.length - 1].v;
};

/**
 * Damped spring that chases a driver signal, simulated from `start` to `frame`.
 * Used for follow-through on secondary parts (cowlick, antennae, hanging cards):
 * they respond to the parent's motion instead of running their own loop.
 */
export const springFollow = (
  driver: (f: number) => number,
  frame: number,
  { start = 0, stiffness = 180, damping = 12, mass = 1, fps = 60, substeps = 2 } = {},
) => {
  let x = driver(start);
  let v = 0;
  const dt = 1 / fps / substeps;
  const end = Math.max(start, Math.floor(frame));
  for (let f = start; f < end; f++) {
    const target = driver(f + 1);
    for (let s = 0; s < substeps; s++) {
      const a = (-stiffness * (x - target) - damping * v) / mass;
      v += a * dt;
      x += v * dt;
    }
  }
  return { value: x, offset: x - driver(end), velocity: v };
};

/** Step a continuous value to a limited frame rate, the way sprite animation holds poses. */
export const onTwos = (frame: number, step = 2) => Math.floor(frame / step) * step;

==== 1536 src/kits/voxelverse/core/noise.ts
// Seeded randomness and smooth noise. No Math.random anywhere in the system.

export const hash = (n: number) => {
  let x = Math.imul(n ^ 0x9e3779b9, 0x85ebca6b);
  x ^= x >>> 13;
  x = Math.imul(x, 0xc2b2ae35);
  x ^= x >>> 16;
  return (x >>> 0) / 4294967296;
};

export const hash2 = (a: number, b: number) => hash(Math.imul(a | 0, 73856093) ^ Math.imul(b | 0, 19349663));

/** Seeded generator for building sets (book spines, tile orders, star fields). */
export const rng = (seed: number) => {
  let s = seed >>> 0 || 1;
  return () => {
    s ^= s << 13;
    s ^= s >>> 17;
    s ^= s << 5;
    return (s >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
};

const fade = (t: number) => t * t * t * (t * (t * 6 - 15) + 10);

/** 1D value noise in [-1, 1]. */
export const noise1 = (x: number, seed = 0) => {
  const i = Math.floor(x);
  const f = x - i;
  const a = hash(i + seed * 1013) * 2 - 1;
  const b = hash(i + 1 + seed * 1013) * 2 - 1;
  return a + (b - a) * fade(f);
};

/** Fractal 1D noise, for drifts and flicker that never visibly loop. */
export const fbm1 = (x: number, seed = 0, octaves = 3) => {
  let sum = 0;
  let amp = 0.5;
  let freq = 1;
  for (let o = 0; o < octaves; o++) {
    sum += noise1(x * freq, seed + o * 17) * amp;
    amp *= 0.5;
    freq *= 2.03;
  }
  return sum;
};

// 4×4 Bayer matrix, normalised to (0,1). Used to dither between colour-ramp steps.
const BAYER4 = [0, 8, 2, 10, 12, 4, 14, 6, 3, 11, 1, 9, 15, 7, 13, 5];
export const bayer = (x: number, y: number) => (BAYER4[(y & 3) * 4 + (x & 3)] + 0.5) / 16;

==== 8987 src/kits/voxelverse/example/VoxelverseExample.tsx
// VOXELVERSE technical example — a small voxel street at dusk on its diorama plinth, 8 s at any fps.
// Spec-driven buildings, street lamps, windows that light up in a sweep from west to east, rain that
// starts, and one continuous crane move from street level back and up until the cut-away plinth shows.
// It is a technical check and a starting point, not a story: never reuse it as a buyer's film.
//
// Every time below is a film frame on a 60 fps clock (`f`), so preview (30 fps) and final (60 fps) match.

import React, { useCallback } from "react";
import { AbsoluteFill, useCurrentFrame, useVideoConfig } from "remotion";
import { ThreeCanvas } from "@remotion/three";
import { PCFShadowMap } from "three";
import { clamp, ease, lerp, ramp } from "../core/motion";
import { hash } from "../core/noise";
import { C } from "../lib/palette";
import { GlowPanes, VoxModel, type Pane } from "../lib/components";
import type { V3, Vox } from "../lib/voxel";
import { cameraAt, type Shot } from "../camera/rig";
import { CameraRig, Post } from "../camera/Post";
import { DuskLight, Environment, Fog, Sky } from "../world/Atmosphere";
import { Plinth, type PlinthSpec } from "../world/Plinth";
import { Buildings, buildingHeight, type BuildingSpec, type GlowFn, type Placement } from "../world/Building";
import { Rain } from "../world/Rain";

export const VOXELVERSE_EXAMPLE_SECONDS = 8;
const FILM_FPS = 60;
const s = (sec: number) => Math.round(sec * FILM_FPS);

const PLINTH: PlinthSpec = {
  minX: -12, maxX: 12, minZ: -13, maxZ: 13,
  roadHalf: 2.6, curb: 0.15, walkOuter: 5, baseDepth: 3.2, crossingX: 3.5,
  puddles: [[-6.5, 1.2, 1.6, 0.6], [2.0, -1.9, 1.2, 0.5], [8.5, 1.6, 1.4, 0.5], [-1.0, 3.6, 0.9, 0.4]],
};

const FRONT = PLINTH.walkOuter;
const north = (cx: number): Placement => ({ pos: [cx, 0, -FRONT], rotY: 0 });
const south = (cx: number): Placement => ({ pos: [cx, 0, FRONT], rotY: Math.PI });

const STREET: { spec: BuildingSpec; at: Placement }[] = [
  { at: north(-8), spec: { w: 7, depth: 7.5, ground: 4.0, floors: [3.2], wall: "brick", wallColor: C.brickDark, trim: C.stoneLight, win: "arched", bays: 4, winW: 1.1, winH: 2.2, roof: "saw", roofColor: C.copperPatina, shop: "depot", extras: ["chimney"], seed: 11 } },
  { at: north(-1.75), spec: { w: 5.5, depth: 7, ground: 3.4, floors: [3.0, 3.0, 3.0], wall: "plaster", wallColor: C.cream, trim: C.teal, win: "tall", bays: 2, winW: 0.9, winH: 1.9, roof: "mansard", roofColor: C.tealDeep, shop: "bakery", shopColor: C.copper, extras: ["balconies", "plants", "shutters"], seed: 12 } },
  { at: north(4.25), spec: { w: 6.5, depth: 7.5, ground: 3.6, floors: [3.2, 3.2], wall: "stone", wallColor: C.stoneLight, trim: C.stoneDark, win: "band", bays: 3, winW: 1.0, winH: 1.6, roof: "stepped", roofColor: C.stone, shop: "arcade", shopColor: C.stoneDark, extras: ["ac"], seed: 13 } },
  { at: north(9.7), spec: { w: 4.4, depth: 7, ground: 3.4, floors: [3.0, 3.0, 3.0, 3.0], wall: "brick", wallColor: C.brick, trim: C.cream, win: "tall", bays: 2, winW: 0.95, winH: 1.8, roof: "flat", roofColor: C.stoneDark, shop: "none", extras: ["fireEscape", "tank", "plants"], seed: 14 } },
  { at: south(-7.8), spec: { w: 8, depth: 7.5, ground: 4.6, floors: [], wall: "stone", wallColor: C.stone, trim: C.copper, win: "arched", bays: 4, winW: 1.4, winH: 2.6, roof: "gable", roofColor: C.copperPatina, shop: "market", shopColor: C.copper, seed: 21 } },
  { at: south(-0.8), spec: { w: 6, depth: 7, ground: 3.8, floors: [3.2, 3.2], wall: "brick", wallColor: C.brickLight, trim: C.cream, win: "arched", bays: 3, winW: 1.1, winH: 1.9, roof: "mansard", roofColor: C.copperDark, shop: "bakery", shopColor: C.teal, extras: ["shutters", "plants", "chimney"], seed: 22 } },
  { at: south(7.0), spec: { w: 9.6, depth: 7.5, ground: 3.6, floors: [3.1, 3.1], wall: "plaster", wallColor: C.plasterRose, trim: C.creamDark, win: "pair", bays: 3, winW: 1.5, winH: 1.5, roof: "flat", roofColor: C.copperPatina, shop: "workshop", shopColor: C.tealDeep, extras: ["tower", "ac"], seed: 23 } },
];

/** Rain stays out of the buildings: a point is blocked if it is inside a footprint below the roofline. */
const FOOTPRINTS = STREET.map(({ spec, at }) => {
  const zs = [at.pos[2], at.pos[2] - Math.cos(at.rotY) * spec.depth];
  return { x0: at.pos[0] - spec.w / 2, x1: at.pos[0] + spec.w / 2, z0: Math.min(...zs), z1: Math.max(...zs), top: buildingHeight(spec) + 3 };
});
const blocked = (x: number, y: number, z: number) => FOOTPRINTS.some((b) => x > b.x0 && x < b.x1 && z > b.z0 && z < b.z1 && y < b.top);
const groundY = (_x: number, z: number) => (Math.abs(z) > PLINTH.roadHalf ? PLINTH.curb : 0.035);

/** Windows light up in a sweep from west to east between 1.2 s and 4.5 s; a few are lit from the start. */
const windowGlow: GlowFn = ({ pos, floor, seed, shop }) => {
  const strength = shop ? 1 : 0.75 + hash(seed * 7) * 0.6;
  if (!shop && hash(seed * 3 + 1) < 0.12) return () => strength;
  if (!shop && hash(seed * 5 + 2) > 0.85) return () => 0;
  const start = s(1.2) + ((pos[0] - PLINTH.minX) / (PLINTH.maxX - PLINTH.minX)) * s(3.0) + floor * 6 + hash(seed) * 24;
  // a switch-on with one quick flicker, then steady
  return (f) => {
    const t = f - start;
    if (t < 0) return 0;
    if (t < 3) return strength * 0.6;
    if (t < 6) return strength * 0.15;
    return strength * Math.min(1, 0.6 + (t - 6) * 0.05);
  };
};

/* street lamps: a post on each walk, lamp heads as glow panes, real point lights for the pools */
const LAMPS: [number, number][] = [[-6, -1], [-1.5, 1], [4.5, -1], [9.5, 1]].map(([x, side]) => [x, side * (PLINTH.roadHalf + 0.45)]);
const lampPosts = (v: Vox) => {
  for (const [x, z] of LAMPS) {
    const out = z < 0 ? 1 : -1; // the arm reaches over the road
    v.prism([x, PLINTH.curb + 0.15, z], 0.16, 0.3, C.ink, { sides: 8, mat: "metal" });
    v.span([x - 0.05, PLINTH.curb, z - 0.05], [x + 0.05, 4.2, z + 0.05], C.ink, { mat: "metal", r: 0.015 });
    v.span([x - 0.04, 4.1, z], [x + 0.04, 4.18, z + out * 0.8], C.ink, { mat: "metal", r: 0.01 });
    v.span([x - 0.16, 3.98, z + out * 0.62], [x + 0.16, 4.1, z + out * 0.98], C.ink, { mat: "metal", r: 0.02 });
  }
};
const LAMP_ON = s(0.8);
const lampLevel = (f: number) => {
  const t = f - LAMP_ON;
  return t < 0 ? 0 : t < 3 ? 0.5 : t < 6 ? 0.1 : clamp(0.5 + (t - 6) * 0.04);
};
const LAMP_PANES: Pane[] = LAMPS.map(([x, z]): Pane => {
  const out = z < 0 ? 1 : -1;
  const pos: V3 = [x, 3.975, z + out * 0.8];
  return { pos, size: [0.28, 0.3], rotY: 0, tint: 0xffcf86, glow: (f) => 3 * lampLevel(f) };
});

/* camera: one continuous crane from street level, back past the plinth edge and up */
const SHOTS: Shot[] = [
  {
    name: "street to diorama",
    from: 0,
    to: s(VOXELVERSE_EXAMPLE_SECONDS),
    keys: [
      { f: 0, pos: [-9.5, 1.7, -3.6], at: [-2, 3.2, 5], fov: 44 },
      { f: s(3.0), pos: [-11, 3.4, -2.5], at: [-1, 3.4, 4], fov: 43 },
      { f: s(5.4), pos: [-23, 13, 1], at: [1, 2, 1], fov: 41 },
      { f: s(VOXELVERSE_EXAMPLE_SECONDS), pos: [-44, 32, 5], at: [2, 0, 0], fov: 40 },
    ],
    focus: (f) => (f < s(3) ? [-2, 3, 5] : [0, 1.5, 0]),
    aperture: (f) => lerp(0.0018, 0.0004, clamp((f - s(2.5)) / s(3))),
    maxBlur: 0.01,
    exposure: 1.0,
    fog: 0.012,
    handheld: 0.004,
  },
];

const World: React.FC<{ f: number }> = ({ f }) => {
  const cam = cameraAt(SHOTS, f);
  const k = ease.cameraSoft(clamp(f / s(VOXELVERSE_EXAMPLE_SECONDS)));
  const glow = useCallback<GlowFn>((p) => windowGlow(p), []);
  const rain = ramp(f, s(2.2), s(3.6));
  const lamp = lampLevel(f);
  return (
    <>
      <CameraRig cam={cam} />
      <Sky boost={1 - 0.3 * k} />
      <Environment />
      <Fog density={lerp(0.014, 0.0028, k)} />
      <DuskLight from={[-16, 30, 26]} size={22} intensity={1.1 - 0.3 * k} />
      <Plinth spec={PLINTH} />
      <Buildings list={STREET} glow={glow} f={f} />
      <VoxModel build={lampPosts} seed={31} />
      <GlowPanes panes={LAMP_PANES} f={f} />
      {LAMPS.map(([x, z], i) => (
        <pointLight key={i} position={[x, 3.7, z + (z < 0 ? 0.8 : -0.8)]} color={C.lampWarm} intensity={lamp * 7} distance={7} decay={2} />
      ))}
      <Rain cam={cam} f={f} amount={rain * 0.55} wide={rain * k * 0.7} bounds={{ minX: PLINTH.minX, maxX: PLINTH.maxX, minZ: PLINTH.minZ, maxZ: PLINTH.maxZ, height: 22 }} blocked={blocked} groundY={groundY} />
      <Post cam={cam} frame={f} />
    </>
  );
};

export const VoxelverseExample: React.FC = () => {
  const frame = useCurrentFrame();
  const { fps, width, height } = useVideoConfig();
  const f = (frame / fps) * FILM_FPS;
  return (
    <AbsoluteFill style={{ backgroundColor: "#1d2a2b" }}>
      <ThreeCanvas width={width} height={height} shadows={{ type: PCFShadowMap }} dpr={1}
        gl={{ antialias: false, preserveDrawingBuffer: true, powerPreference: "high-performance" }}
        camera={{ fov: 44, near: 0.03, far: 600, position: [0, 3, 10] }}>
        <World f={f} />
      </ThreeCanvas>
    </AbsoluteFill>
  );
};

==== 3686 src/kits/voxelverse/lib/anim.ts
// Character-animation helpers on top of the engine's motion primitives.

import { Quaternion, Vector3 } from "three";
import { clamp, lerp, ease } from "../core/motion";
import type { V3 } from "./voxel";

export const v3lerp = (a: V3, b: V3, t: number): V3 => [lerp(a[0], b[0], t), lerp(a[1], b[1], t), lerp(a[2], b[2], t)];

/** Yaw (about +Y, 0 = facing +Z) and pitch (positive = looking up) from one point to another. */
export const lookAngles = (from: V3, to: V3) => {
  const dx = to[0] - from[0], dy = to[1] - from[1], dz = to[2] - from[2];
  return { yaw: Math.atan2(dx, dz), pitch: Math.atan2(dy, Math.hypot(dx, dz)) };
};

/**
 * Look-target schedule: each entry takes over at `f` and is blended in over `blend`
 * frames, so attention shifts read as decisions, not interpolation.
 */
export type LookKey = { f: number; at: (frame: number) => V3; blend?: number };
export const lookTarget = (frame: number, keys: LookKey[]): V3 => {
  let cur = keys[0].at(frame);
  for (let i = 1; i < keys.length; i++) {
    const k = keys[i];
    if (frame < k.f) break;
    const t = ease.body(clamp((frame - k.f) / (k.blend ?? 12)));
    cur = v3lerp(cur, k.at(frame), t);
  }
  return cur;
};

/** 0 = open, 1 = shut. Quick close, short hold, slower open. */
export const blink = (frame: number, at: number[]) => {
  for (const b of at) {
    const t = frame - b;
    if (t < 0 || t > 9) continue;
    if (t < 2) return t / 2;
    if (t < 4) return 1;
    return 1 - (t - 4) / 5;
  }
  return 0;
};

/** Squash-and-stretch for a hop: returns {y, sy} given takeoff and landing frames. */
export const hop = (frame: number, takeoff: number, land: number, height: number) => {
  const pre = 7; // anticipation squash
  const post = 9; // landing squash + recovery
  if (frame < takeoff - pre || frame > land + post) return { y: 0, sy: 1 };
  if (frame < takeoff) {
    const t = (frame - (takeoff - pre)) / pre;
    return { y: 0, sy: 1 - 0.2 * ease.body(t) };
  }
  if (frame <= land) {
    const t = (frame - takeoff) / (land - takeoff);
    const y = 4 * height * t * (1 - t);
    const sy = 1 + 0.16 * (1 - Math.abs(t * 2 - 1)) * (t < 0.5 ? 1 : 0.6);
    return { y, sy };
  }
  const t = (frame - land) / post;
  return { y: 0, sy: 1 - 0.18 * Math.sin(Math.PI * t) * (1 - t * 0.5) };
};

const _a = new Vector3();
const _b = new Vector3();
const _p = new Vector3();
const _q = new Quaternion();
const DOWN = new Vector3(0, -1, 0);

/**
 * Two-bone IK in the parent's space. Bones hang along -Y at rest.
 * Returns quaternions for the upper bone (in parent space) and the lower bone
 * (in upper-bone space). `pole` is the direction the elbow/knee should point.
 */
export const twoBoneIK = (shoulder: V3, target: V3, l1: number, l2: number, pole: V3) => {
  const S = new Vector3(...shoulder);
  const T = new Vector3(...target);
  const dir = _a.copy(T).sub(S);
  let d = dir.length();
  d = clamp(d, Math.abs(l1 - l2) + 1e-3, l1 + l2 - 1e-3);
  dir.normalize();
  const cosA = clamp((l1 * l1 + d * d - l2 * l2) / (2 * l1 * d), -1, 1);
  const sinA = Math.sqrt(1 - cosA * cosA);
  const P = _p.set(...pole).normalize();
  const poleP = _b.copy(P).sub(dir.clone().multiplyScalar(P.dot(dir))).normalize();
  const E = S.clone().add(dir.clone().multiplyScalar(l1 * cosA)).add(poleP.clone().multiplyScalar(l1 * sinA));
  const upperDir = E.clone().sub(S).normalize();
  const qU = new Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(DOWN, upperDir);
  const W = S.clone().add(dir.clone().multiplyScalar(d)); // reachable wrist point
  const lowerDir = W.sub(E).normalize().applyQuaternion(_q.copy(qU).invert());
  const qL = new Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(DOWN, lowerDir);
  return { qU, qL };
};

==== 3463 src/kits/voxelverse/lib/components.tsx
// React wrappers around the voxel kit and the instanced glow panes.

import React, { useLayoutEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import { Color, InstancedBufferAttribute, InstancedMesh, Matrix4, PlaneGeometry, Quaternion, Euler, Vector3, Texture } from "three";
import { useCurrentFrame } from "remotion";
import { mats, makeGlowPaneMaterial } from "./materials";
import { Vox } from "./voxel";

/** A static voxel model: authored once, merged per material, shadows on. */
export const VoxModel: React.FC<{
  build: (v: Vox) => void;
  seed?: number;
  castShadow?: boolean;
  receiveShadow?: boolean;
  position?: [number, number, number];
  rotation?: [number, number, number];
}> = ({ build, seed = 1, castShadow = true, receiveShadow = true, position, rotation }) => {
  const parts = useMemo(() => {
    const v = new Vox(seed);
    build(v);
    return v.build();
    // Models are authored once; `build` is a stable module-level function.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);
  const m = mats();
  return (
    <group position={position} rotation={rotation}>
      {parts.map(([k, g]) => (
        <mesh key={k} geometry={g} material={m[k]} castShadow={castShadow} receiveShadow={receiveShadow} />
      ))}
    </group>
  );
};

export type Pane = {
  pos: [number, number, number];
  size: [number, number];
  /** rotation about Y (0 = facing +Z) */
  rotY: number;
  tint: number | Color;
  cell?: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3;
  /** emission as a pure function of the frame */
  glow: (frame: number) => number;
};

const CELLS: [number, number][] = [
  [0, 0],
  [0.5, 0],
  [0, 0.5],
  [0.5, 0.5],
];

/**
 * Every lit-able window or bulb in a set of panes, as one instanced draw call. `f` is the clock passed to
 * each pane's `glow` (pass film frames on a 60 fps clock so preview and final match); defaults to the
 * composition frame.
 */
export const GlowPanes: React.FC<{ panes: Pane[]; atlas?: Texture | null; base?: number; castShadow?: boolean; f?: number }> = ({
  panes,
  atlas = null,
  base,
  f,
}) => {
  const current = useCurrentFrame();
  const frame = f ?? current;
  const { mesh, glow } = useMemo(() => {
    const geo = new PlaneGeometry(1, 1);
    const n = panes.length;
    const glowAttr = new InstancedBufferAttribute(new Float32Array(n), 1);
    const tint = new Float32Array(n * 3);
    const cell = new Float32Array(n * 2);
    const mesh = new InstancedMesh(geo, makeGlowPaneMaterial(atlas, base), n);
    const m = new Matrix4();
    const q = new Quaternion();
    const e = new Euler();
    const c = new Color();
    panes.forEach((p, i) => {
      m.compose(new Vector3(...p.pos), q.setFromEuler(e.set(0, p.rotY, 0)), new Vector3(p.size[0], p.size[1], 1));
      mesh.setMatrixAt(i, m);
      c.set(p.tint as Color);
      tint.set([c.r, c.g, c.b], i * 3);
      cell.set(CELLS[p.cell ?? 0], i * 2);
    });
    geo.setAttribute("aGlow", glowAttr);
    geo.setAttribute("aTint", new InstancedBufferAttribute(tint, 3));
    geo.setAttribute("aCell", new InstancedBufferAttribute(cell, 2));
    mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
    mesh.receiveShadow = false;
    mesh.castShadow = false;
    mesh.frustumCulled = false;
    return { mesh, glow: glowAttr };
  }, [panes, atlas, base]);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    for (let i = 0; i < panes.length; i++) glow.array[i] = panes[i].glow(frame);
    glow.needsUpdate = true;
  }, [frame, panes, glow]);

  return <primitive object={mesh} />;
};

==== 7145 src/kits/voxelverse/lib/kit.ts
// Reusable architectural pieces for the voxel kit: brick walls with openings,
// window frames, sills, planters. Authored in a local frame where the wall plane
// is z = 0 and the outside faces +Z; place them with `v.at(...)`.

import { C } from "./palette";
import type { Vox, V3 } from "./voxel";

export type Hole = [number, number, number, number]; // x0, x1, y0, y1

const BRICKS = [C.brick, C.brick, C.brickLight, C.brickDark, C.brick, 0xa65a3f];

/** Running-bond brick skin with mortar backing; openings are cut cleanly. */
export const brickWall = (
  v: Vox,
  x0: number,
  x1: number,
  y0: number,
  y1: number,
  holes: Hole[] = [],
  { len = 0.42, h = 0.2, gap = 0.028, depth = 0.1, back = 0.24, palette = BRICKS as number[] } = {},
) => {
  // Mortar backing as solid slabs around the holes.
  slabWithHoles(v, x0, x1, y0, y1, -back, 0, holes, C.mortar);
  const pitch = h + gap;
  let row = 0;
  for (let y = y0 + gap / 2; y + h <= y1 + 1e-6; y += pitch, row++) {
    const yc0 = y, yc1 = y + h;
    const off = row % 2 === 0 ? 0 : len / 2;
    for (let bx = x0 - off; bx < x1; bx += len + gap) {
      let segs: [number, number][] = [[Math.max(x0, bx), Math.min(x1, bx + len)]];
      for (const [hx0, hx1, hy0, hy1] of holes) {
        if (yc1 <= hy0 || yc0 >= hy1) continue;
        segs = segs.flatMap(([a, b]) => {
          const out: [number, number][] = [];
          if (a < hx0) out.push([a, Math.min(b, hx0 - gap / 2)]);
          if (b > hx1) out.push([Math.max(a, hx1 + gap / 2), b]);
          return out;
        });
      }
      for (const [a, b] of segs) {
        if (b - a < 0.06) continue;
        const col = palette[Math.floor(v.rand() * palette.length)];
        // Bricks sit a hair proud or recessed at random: hand-laid, not extruded.
        const proud = depth / 2 + (v.rand() - 0.5) * 0.012;
        v.box([(a + b) / 2, (yc0 + yc1) / 2, proud - depth / 2 + 0.0], [b - a, h, depth], col, {
          jitter: 0.07,
          r: 0.022,
        });
      }
    }
  }
};

/** Solid slab between z0..z1 covering a rectangle minus rectangular holes. */
export const slabWithHoles = (
  v: Vox,
  x0: number,
  x1: number,
  y0: number,
  y1: number,
  z0: number,
  z1: number,
  holes: Hole[],
  color: number,
  mat: "matte" | "satin" = "matte",
) => {
  // Split into horizontal bands at every hole edge, then fill each band between holes.
  const ys = [...new Set([y0, y1, ...holes.flatMap((h) => [h[2], h[3]])])].filter((y) => y >= y0 && y <= y1).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  for (let i = 0; i < ys.length - 1; i++) {
    const ya = ys[i], yb = ys[i + 1];
    const inBand = holes.filter((h) => h[2] < yb - 1e-6 && h[3] > ya + 1e-6).sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]);
    let x = x0;
    for (const h of inBand) {
      if (h[0] > x + 1e-6) v.span([x, ya, z0], [h[0], yb, z1], color, { r: 0.01, mat });
      x = Math.max(x, h[1]);
    }
    if (x < x1 - 1e-6) v.span([x, ya, z0], [x1, yb, z1], color, { r: 0.01, mat });
  }
};

/** Window frame with mullions and a transom, set into an opening. */
export const windowFrame = (
  v: Vox,
  [x0, x1, y0, y1]: Hole,
  {
    color = C.tealDeep as number,
    t = 0.08,
    depth = 0.14,
    z = -0.12,
    mullions = [] as readonly number[],
    transom = null as number | null,
  } = {},
) => {
  const o = { mat: "satin" as const, r: 0.015 };
  v.span([x0, y0, z - depth / 2], [x1, y0 + t, z + depth / 2], color, o);
  v.span([x0, y1 - t, z - depth / 2], [x1, y1, z + depth / 2], color, o);
  v.span([x0, y0, z - depth / 2], [x0 + t, y1, z + depth / 2], color, o);
  v.span([x1 - t, y0, z - depth / 2], [x1, y1, z + depth / 2], color, o);
  for (const m of mullions) v.span([m - t / 2, y0, z - depth / 2], [m + t / 2, y1, z + depth / 2], color, o);
  if (transom !== null) v.span([x0, transom - t / 2, z - depth / 2], [x1, transom + t / 2, z + depth / 2], color, o);
};

/** Projecting stone sill below an opening. */
export const sill = (v: Vox, x0: number, x1: number, y: number, color: number = C.stoneLight, out = 0.2) => {
  v.span([x0 - 0.12, y - 0.12, -0.05], [x1 + 0.12, y, out], color, { mat: "wet", r: 0.02, jitter: 0.03 });
};

/** Small leafy cluster — a few offset cubes, darker inside, lighter on top. */
export const shrub = (v: Vox, [x, y, z]: V3, size = 0.3, seedShift = 0) => {
  const n = 7 + Math.floor(v.rand() * 4);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const s = size * (0.45 + v.rand() * 0.4);
    const px = x + (v.rand() - 0.5) * size * 1.2;
    const py = y + v.rand() * size * 0.9;
    const pz = z + (v.rand() - 0.5) * size * 1.0;
    const top = py > y + size * 0.45;
    v.box([px, py, pz], [s, s * 0.85, s], top ? C.leafLight : (i + seedShift) % 2 ? C.leaf : C.leafDark, {
      mat: "foliage",
      jitter: 0.1,
      rot: [0, v.rand() * 0.6, 0],
    });
  }
};

/** Copper downpipe with brackets, from top to bottom along Y. */
export const downpipe = (v: Vox, [x, z]: [number, number], yTop: number, yBottom: number) => {
  v.span([x - 0.06, yBottom + 0.2, z - 0.06], [x + 0.06, yTop, z + 0.06], C.copper, { mat: "metal", r: 0.02 });
  v.span([x - 0.07, yBottom, z - 0.07], [x + 0.07, yBottom + 0.22, z + 0.2], C.copper, { mat: "metal", r: 0.02 });
  for (let y = yBottom + 1.1; y < yTop - 0.3; y += 1.5) {
    v.span([x - 0.09, y, z - 0.12], [x + 0.09, y + 0.05, z + 0.08], C.copperDark, { mat: "metal", r: 0.01 });
  }
};

/** Herb pot detail for close-ups: stems with pairs of flat leaves, turned outward. */
export const herbs = (v: Vox, [x, y, z]: V3, height = 0.22, stems = 5, color: number = C.leaf) => {
  for (let i = 0; i < stems; i++) {
    const a = (i / stems) * Math.PI * 2 + v.rand() * 0.6;
    const lean = 0.12 + v.rand() * 0.25;
    const h = height * (0.65 + v.rand() * 0.45);
    const top: V3 = [x + Math.cos(a) * h * lean, y + h, z + Math.sin(a) * h * lean];
    v.rod([x, y, z], top, 0.012, C.leafDark, { mat: "foliage" });
    const pairs = 2 + Math.floor(v.rand() * 2);
    for (let k = 0; k < pairs; k++) {
      const t = 0.45 + (k / pairs) * 0.55;
      const p: V3 = [x + (top[0] - x) * t, y + (top[1] - y) * t, z + (top[2] - z) * t];
      for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
        const ya = a + side * 1.3 + k * 0.7;
        const s = 0.05 + (1 - k / pairs) * 0.03;
        v.at(p, [0.35 * side, ya, 0.25], () =>
          v.box([s * 0.55, 0, 0], [s, 0.011, s * 0.62], k === pairs - 1 ? C.leafLight : color, { mat: "foliage", jitter: 0.08, r: 0.004 }),
        );
      }
    }
    v.box([top[0], top[1] + 0.012, top[2]], [0.04, 0.012, 0.035], C.leafLight, { mat: "foliage", rot: [0, a, 0], r: 0.004 });
  }
};

/** Trailing ivy spilling over an edge and hanging down. */
export const ivy = (v: Vox, [x, y, z]: V3, length = 0.4) => {
  let p: V3 = [x, y, z];
  const n = Math.round(length / 0.045);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const q: V3 = [p[0] + (v.rand() - 0.5) * 0.03, p[1] - 0.045, p[2] + 0.004];
    v.rod(p, q, 0.008, C.leafDark, { mat: "foliage" });
    if (i % 2 === 0) v.box([q[0] + (i % 4 === 0 ? 0.022 : -0.022), q[1], q[2] + 0.01], [0.04, 0.034, 0.008], i % 3 ? C.leaf : C.leafLight, { mat: "foliage", rot: [0.3, 0, i % 4 === 0 ? -0.5 : 0.5], r: 0.003 });
    p = q;
  }
};

==== 173 src/kits/voxelverse/lib/layers.ts
// Render layers. Additive light effects (cones, halos, rain, pulses) live on FX_LAYER
// so depth-based passes (AO, depth of field) ignore them.
export const FX_LAYER = 1;

==== 4133 src/kits/voxelverse/lib/materials.ts
// Shared materials. Surfaces are grouped by how they respond to light, not by what
// they depict: colour lives in the vertex data, response lives here.

import {
  AdditiveBlending,
  Color,
  DoubleSide,
  MeshBasicMaterial,
  MeshStandardMaterial,
  ShaderMaterial,
  Texture,
} from "three";
import type { MatKey } from "./voxel";

const std = (roughness: number, metalness = 0, extra: Partial<MeshStandardMaterial> = {}) =>
  Object.assign(new MeshStandardMaterial({ vertexColors: true, roughness, metalness }), extra);

let cache: Record<MatKey, MeshStandardMaterial> | null = null;
export const mats = () =>
  (cache ??= {
    matte: std(0.86),
    fabric: std(0.97),
    foliage: std(0.75),
    satin: std(0.48),
    // Rain-soaked horizontal surfaces: low roughness so lamps leave real highlights.
    wet: std(0.24, 0, { envMapIntensity: 1.25 }),
    metal: std(0.34, 0.85),
    gloss: std(0.1, 0, { envMapIntensity: 1.4 }),
  });

/**
 * Instanced emissive panes (windows, bulbs, signs). Each instance carries
 *   aGlow  — emission strength, animated per frame
 *   aTint  — linear RGB colour of the light behind the pane
 *   aCell  — atlas cell offset (u, v) into a 2×2 interior atlas
 * Unlit panes keep a dark, reflective glass response.
 */
export const makeGlowPaneMaterial = (atlas: Texture | null, base = 0x1b2426) => {
  const m = new MeshStandardMaterial({
    color: base,
    roughness: 0.14,
    metalness: 0.0,
    emissive: new Color(1, 1, 1),
    emissiveMap: atlas,
    envMapIntensity: 1.1,
  });
  m.onBeforeCompile = (sh) => {
    sh.vertexShader = sh.vertexShader
      .replace(
        "#include <common>",
        `#include <common>
attribute float aGlow; attribute vec3 aTint; attribute vec2 aCell;
varying float vGlow; varying vec3 vTint; varying vec2 vCell;`,
      )
      .replace("#include <begin_vertex>", `#include <begin_vertex>\n vGlow = aGlow; vTint = aTint; vCell = aCell;`);
    sh.fragmentShader = sh.fragmentShader
      .replace(
        "#include <common>",
        `#include <common>
varying float vGlow; varying vec3 vTint; varying vec2 vCell;`,
      )
      .replace(
        "#include <emissivemap_fragment>",
        atlas
          ? `vec3 interior = texture2D(emissiveMap, vCell + vEmissiveMapUv * 0.5).rgb;
totalEmissiveRadiance = interior * vTint * vGlow;
diffuseColor.rgb *= 1.0 - clamp(vGlow, 0.0, 1.0) * 0.85;`
          : `totalEmissiveRadiance = vTint * vGlow;
diffuseColor.rgb *= 1.0 - clamp(vGlow, 0.0, 1.0) * 0.85;`,
      );
  };
  m.customProgramCacheKey = () => (atlas ? "glowpane-atlas" : "glowpane");
  return m;
};

/** Unlit additive glow (light cones, wet-road streaks, halos). Opacity is driven per object. */
export const additive = (map: Texture, color: number | Color, opacity = 1) =>
  new MeshBasicMaterial({
    map,
    color,
    transparent: true,
    opacity,
    blending: AdditiveBlending,
    depthWrite: false,
    side: DoubleSide,
    toneMapped: true,
    fog: false,
  });

/** Soft volumetric cone under a lamp: fades along its length and towards its silhouette. */
export const makeConeMaterial = (color: number) =>
  new ShaderMaterial({
    uniforms: { uColor: { value: new Color(color) }, uIntensity: { value: 0 } },
    vertexShader: /* glsl */ `
      varying float vH; varying vec3 vN; varying vec3 vView;
      void main() {
        vH = uv.y;
        vec4 mv = modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
        vN = normalize(normalMatrix * normal);
        vView = normalize(-mv.xyz);
        gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mv;
      }`,
    fragmentShader: /* glsl */ `
      uniform vec3 uColor; uniform float uIntensity;
      varying float vH; varying vec3 vN; varying vec3 vView;
      void main() {
        float facing = abs(dot(normalize(vN), normalize(vView)));
        float edge = smoothstep(0.0, 0.85, facing);
        float along = pow(vH, 1.6);           // uv.y = 1 at the lamp, 0 at the ground
        float a = edge * along * uIntensity;
        gl_FragColor = vec4(uColor * a, 1.0);
      }`,
    transparent: true,
    blending: AdditiveBlending,
    depthWrite: false,
    side: DoubleSide,
  });
