==== 4261 src/kits/voxelverse/lib/textures.ts
// Procedural canvas textures. All drawing is seeded, so every render tab produces
// identical pixels.

import { CanvasTexture, LinearFilter, SRGBColorSpace } from "three";
import { rng } from "../core/noise";

const canvas = (w: number, h: number) => {
  const c = document.createElement("canvas");
  c.width = w;
  c.height = h;
  return [c, c.getContext("2d")!] as const;
};

const tex = (c: HTMLCanvasElement, srgb = true) => {
  const t = new CanvasTexture(c);
  if (srgb) t.colorSpace = SRGBColorSpace;
  t.minFilter = LinearFilter;
  t.generateMipmaps = false;
  return t;
};

const memo = <T,>(fn: () => T) => {
  let v: T | null = null;
  return () => (v ??= fn());
};

/** Soft round falloff, white → transparent (halos, ground pools). */
export const radialTex = memo(() => {
  const [c, g] = canvas(128, 128);
  const gr = g.createRadialGradient(64, 64, 0, 64, 64, 64);
  gr.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,1)");
  gr.addColorStop(0.25, "rgba(255,255,255,0.55)");
  gr.addColorStop(0.6, "rgba(255,255,255,0.12)");
  gr.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
  g.fillStyle = gr;
  g.fillRect(0, 0, 128, 128);
  return tex(c);
});

/** Long vertical smear for lamp reflections on wet asphalt. */
export const streakTex = memo(() => {
  const [c, g] = canvas(64, 256);
  const img = g.createImageData(64, 256);
  const r = rng(11);
  for (let y = 0; y < 256; y++) {
    const v = y / 255;
    const along = Math.pow(Math.sin(Math.PI * Math.min(1, v * 1.15)), 1.4) * (1 - v * 0.55);
    // broken by ripples: a few horizontal gaps
    const ripple = 0.75 + 0.25 * Math.sin(y * 0.9 + r() * 0.5) * Math.sin(y * 0.23);
    for (let x = 0; x < 64; x++) {
      const u = (x - 31.5) / 32;
      const a = Math.exp(-u * u * 7) * along * ripple;
      const i = (y * 64 + x) * 4;
      img.data[i] = img.data[i + 1] = img.data[i + 2] = 255;
      img.data[i + 3] = Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, a)) * 255);
    }
  }
  g.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
  return tex(c);
});

/**
 * 2×2 atlas of lit interiors seen through a window, each 128² cell:
 *  (0,0) ceiling lamp + shelf  (0.5,0) half-drawn curtains
 *  (0,0.5) venetian blinds     (0.5,0.5) plant on the sill + table lamp
 * Brightness is baked as a soft gradient so a lit pane never reads as a flat card.
 */
export const interiorAtlas = memo(() => {
  const S = 128;
  const [c, g] = canvas(S * 2, S * 2);
  const base = (ox: number, oy: number, hot: number) => {
    const gr = g.createRadialGradient(ox + S * 0.5, oy + S * 0.18, 4, ox + S * 0.5, oy + S * 0.4, S * 0.9);
    gr.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,236,200,1)`);
    gr.addColorStop(0.35, `rgba(${Math.round(230 * hot)},${Math.round(170 * hot)},${Math.round(110 * hot)},1)`);
    gr.addColorStop(1, "rgba(70,40,26,1)");
    g.fillStyle = gr;
    g.fillRect(ox, oy, S, S);
  };
  // Cell A: lamp + shelf silhouette
  base(0, 0, 1);
  g.fillStyle = "rgba(60,35,22,0.75)";
  g.fillRect(12, 70, 46, 8);
  g.fillRect(16, 52, 8, 18);
  g.fillRect(28, 56, 10, 14);
  g.fillRect(86, 88, 30, 40);
  // Cell B: curtains
  base(S, 0, 1.05);
  g.fillStyle = "rgba(120,52,38,0.9)";
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    g.fillRect(S + i * 8, 0, 7, S);
    g.fillRect(S * 2 - 8 - i * 8, 0, 7, S);
  }
  // Cell C: blinds
  base(0, S, 0.95);
  g.fillStyle = "rgba(80,50,30,0.55)";
  for (let y = 0; y < S; y += 11) g.fillRect(0, S + y, S, 4);
  // Cell D: plant + table lamp
  base(S, S, 1.0);
  g.fillStyle = "rgba(40,48,30,0.85)";
  const r = rng(5);
  for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) g.fillRect(S + 10 + r() * 34, S + 64 + r() * 40, 9, 9);
  g.fillRect(S + 22, S + 100, 14, 28);
  g.fillStyle = "rgba(255,226,170,1)";
  g.fillRect(S + 88, S + 70, 18, 12);
  g.fillStyle = "rgba(60,35,22,0.8)";
  g.fillRect(S + 95, S + 82, 4, 26);
  g.fillRect(S + 70, S + 106, 54, 22);
  return tex(c);
});

export type Glyph = { text: string; color: string };

/** Sign with emissive lettering on a dark panel (café, cinema). */
export const signTex = (text: string, w: number, h: number, font: string, color = "#ffd59a") => {
  const [c, g] = canvas(w, h);
  g.fillStyle = "#000";
  g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
  g.fillStyle = color;
  g.font = font;
  g.textAlign = "center";
  g.textBaseline = "middle";
  g.fillText(text, w / 2, h / 2 + h * 0.04);
  return tex(c);
};

==== 9612 src/kits/voxelverse/lib/voxel.ts
// Voxel modelling kit. Models are authored as lists of chamfered boxes inside a
// transform stack, then merged into one BufferGeometry per material class, with
// per-box vertex colour. A small chamfer on every edge is what makes the world read
// as a crafted miniature instead of default unlit cubes: each edge catches light.

import { BufferAttribute, BufferGeometry, Color, Euler, Matrix3, Matrix4, Quaternion, Vector3 } from "three";
import { rng } from "../core/noise";

export type V3 = [number, number, number];
export type MatKey = "matte" | "satin" | "wet" | "metal" | "gloss" | "fabric" | "foliage";
export type ColorIn = number | string | Color;

type Tri = { p: number[]; n: number[] }; // non-indexed triangles for a unit template

/** Flat-shaded chamfered box template, centred, with half extents and chamfer r. */
const template = (() => {
  const cache = new Map<string, Tri>();
  return (hx: number, hy: number, hz: number, r: number): Tri => {
    const key = `${hx.toFixed(4)}|${hy.toFixed(4)}|${hz.toFixed(4)}|${r.toFixed(4)}`;
    const hit = cache.get(key);
    if (hit) return hit;
    const p: number[] = [];
    const n: number[] = [];
    const poly = (pts: number[][], nx: number, ny: number, nz: number) => {
      const len = Math.hypot(nx, ny, nz);
      const N = [nx / len, ny / len, nz / len];
      // Fix winding so the polygon faces its outward normal.
      const [a, b, c] = pts;
      const ux = b[0] - a[0], uy = b[1] - a[1], uz = b[2] - a[2];
      const vx = c[0] - a[0], vy = c[1] - a[1], vz = c[2] - a[2];
      const cx = uy * vz - uz * vy, cy = uz * vx - ux * vz, cz = ux * vy - uy * vx;
      const ordered = cx * N[0] + cy * N[1] + cz * N[2] < 0 ? [...pts].reverse() : pts;
      for (let i = 1; i < ordered.length - 1; i++) {
        for (const q of [ordered[0], ordered[i], ordered[i + 1]]) {
          p.push(q[0], q[1], q[2]);
          n.push(N[0], N[1], N[2]);
        }
      }
    };
    if (r <= 0) {
      for (const s of [1, -1]) {
        poly([[s * hx, -hy, -hz], [s * hx, hy, -hz], [s * hx, hy, hz], [s * hx, -hy, hz]], s, 0, 0);
        poly([[-hx, s * hy, -hz], [hx, s * hy, -hz], [hx, s * hy, hz], [-hx, s * hy, hz]], 0, s, 0);
        poly([[-hx, -hy, s * hz], [hx, -hy, s * hz], [hx, hy, s * hz], [-hx, hy, s * hz]], 0, 0, s);
      }
    } else {
      const ix = hx - r, iy = hy - r, iz = hz - r;
      for (const s of [1, -1]) {
        poly([[s * hx, -iy, -iz], [s * hx, iy, -iz], [s * hx, iy, iz], [s * hx, -iy, iz]], s, 0, 0);
        poly([[-ix, s * hy, -iz], [ix, s * hy, -iz], [ix, s * hy, iz], [-ix, s * hy, iz]], 0, s, 0);
        poly([[-ix, -iy, s * hz], [ix, -iy, s * hz], [ix, iy, s * hz], [-ix, iy, s * hz]], 0, 0, s);
      }
      for (const a of [1, -1])
        for (const b of [1, -1]) {
          // X-Y edges run along Z
          poly([[a * hx, b * iy, -iz], [a * ix, b * hy, -iz], [a * ix, b * hy, iz], [a * hx, b * iy, iz]], a, b, 0);
          // X-Z edges run along Y
          poly([[a * hx, -iy, b * iz], [a * ix, -iy, b * hz], [a * ix, iy, b * hz], [a * hx, iy, b * iz]], a, 0, b);
          // Y-Z edges run along X
          poly([[-ix, a * hy, b * iz], [-ix, a * iy, b * hz], [ix, a * iy, b * hz], [ix, a * hy, b * iz]], 0, a, b);
        }
      for (const a of [1, -1])
        for (const b of [1, -1])
          for (const c of [1, -1])
            poly([[a * hx, b * iy, c * iz], [a * ix, b * hy, c * iz], [a * ix, b * iy, c * hz]], a, b, c);
    }
    const t = { p, n };
    cache.set(key, t);
    return t;
  };
})();

class Buf {
  data = new Float32Array(1 << 14);
  len = 0;
  push3(a: number, b: number, c: number) {
    if (this.len + 3 > this.data.length) {
      const next = new Float32Array(this.data.length * 2);
      next.set(this.data);
      this.data = next;
    }
    this.data[this.len++] = a;
    this.data[this.len++] = b;
    this.data[this.len++] = c;
  }
  out() {
    return this.data.slice(0, this.len);
  }
}

export type BoxOpts = {
  mat?: MatKey;
  /** chamfer size; default scales with the smallest side */
  r?: number;
  rot?: V3;
  /** ± lightness variation, 0..1 */
  jitter?: number;
};

const _m = new Matrix4();
const _q = new Quaternion();
const _e = new Euler();
const _v = new Vector3();
const _n = new Vector3();
const _c = new Color();
const _s = new Vector3(1, 1, 1);

export class Vox {
  private parts = new Map<MatKey, { p: Buf; n: Buf; c: Buf }>();
  private stack: Matrix4[] = [new Matrix4()];
  readonly rand: () => number;
  count = 0;

  constructor(seed = 1) {
    this.rand = rng(seed);
  }

  private get top() {
    return this.stack[this.stack.length - 1];
  }

  /** Run `fn` inside a local transform (translate, then rotate XYZ). */
  at(pos: V3, rot: V3 | number, fn: () => void) {
    const r: V3 = typeof rot === "number" ? [0, rot, 0] : rot;
    _q.setFromEuler(_e.set(r[0], r[1], r[2]));
    const local = new Matrix4().compose(_v.set(pos[0], pos[1], pos[2]), _q, _s);
    this.stack.push(this.top.clone().multiply(local));
    fn();
    this.stack.pop();
  }

  /** Box centred at p with full size `size`. */
  box(p: V3, size: V3, color: ColorIn, o: BoxOpts = {}) {
    const [w, h, d] = size;
    const minSide = Math.min(w, h, d);
    const r = Math.min(o.r ?? Math.min(0.045, minSide * 0.18), minSide * 0.45);
    const t = template(w / 2, h / 2, d / 2, r);
    const rot = o.rot ?? [0, 0, 0];
    _q.setFromEuler(_e.set(rot[0], rot[1], rot[2]));
    _m.compose(_v.set(p[0], p[1], p[2]), _q, _s).premultiply(this.top);
    const nm = new Matrix3().getNormalMatrix(_m);
    _c.set(color as Color);
    if (o.jitter) {
      const k = 1 + (this.rand() - 0.5) * 2 * o.jitter;
      _c.multiplyScalar(k);
    }
    const key = o.mat ?? "matte";
    let part = this.parts.get(key);
    if (!part) {
      part = { p: new Buf(), n: new Buf(), c: new Buf() };
      this.parts.set(key, part);
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < t.p.length; i += 3) {
      _v.set(t.p[i], t.p[i + 1], t.p[i + 2]).applyMatrix4(_m);
      _n.set(t.n[i], t.n[i + 1], t.n[i + 2]).applyMatrix3(nm).normalize();
      part.p.push3(_v.x, _v.y, _v.z);
      part.n.push3(_n.x, _n.y, _n.z);
      part.c.push3(_c.r, _c.g, _c.b);
    }
    this.count++;
  }

  /** Square-section bar from point a to point b (arms, struts, cables). */
  rod(a: V3, b: V3, t: number, color: ColorIn, o: BoxOpts = {}) {
    const d = new Vector3(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1], b[2] - a[2]);
    const len = d.length();
    const q = new Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(new Vector3(0, 1, 0), d.normalize());
    const e = new Euler().setFromQuaternion(q);
    this.box([(a[0] + b[0]) / 2, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2, (a[2] + b[2]) / 2], [t, len, t], color, { ...o, rot: [e.x, e.y, e.z] });
  }

  /** Prism whose axis points along `dir` (lamp shades, nozzles). */
  prismAlong(p: V3, dir: V3, radius: number, height: number, color: ColorIn, o: BoxOpts & { sides?: number } = {}) {
    const q = new Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(new Vector3(0, 1, 0), new Vector3(...dir).normalize());
    const e = new Euler().setFromQuaternion(q);
    this.prism(p, radius, height, color, { ...o, rot: [e.x, e.y, e.z] });
  }

  /** Axis-aligned box from min corner to max corner. */
  span(a: V3, b: V3, color: ColorIn, o?: BoxOpts) {
    this.box(
      [(a[0] + b[0]) / 2, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2, (a[2] + b[2]) / 2],
      [Math.abs(b[0] - a[0]), Math.abs(b[1] - a[1]), Math.abs(b[2] - a[2])],
      color,
      o,
    );
  }

  /** Flat-shaded N-sided prism along local Y — tanks, pipes, lenses, wheels. */
  prism(p: V3, radius: number, height: number, color: ColorIn, o: BoxOpts & { sides?: number } = {}) {
    const sides = o.sides ?? 8;
    const rot = o.rot ?? [0, 0, 0];
    _q.setFromEuler(_e.set(rot[0], rot[1], rot[2]));
    _m.compose(_v.set(p[0], p[1], p[2]), _q, _s).premultiply(this.top);
    const nm = new Matrix3().getNormalMatrix(_m);
    _c.set(color as Color);
    if (o.jitter) _c.multiplyScalar(1 + (this.rand() - 0.5) * 2 * o.jitter);
    const key = o.mat ?? "matte";
    let part = this.parts.get(key);
    if (!part) {
      part = { p: new Buf(), n: new Buf(), c: new Buf() };
      this.parts.set(key, part);
    }
    const P = part;
    const h = height / 2;
    const ang = (i: number) => (i / sides) * Math.PI * 2 + Math.PI / sides;
    const emit = (pts: number[][], nx: number, ny: number, nz: number) => {
      _n.set(nx, ny, nz).applyMatrix3(nm).normalize();
      for (const q of pts) {
        _v.set(q[0], q[1], q[2]).applyMatrix4(_m);
        P.p.push3(_v.x, _v.y, _v.z);
        P.n.push3(_n.x, _n.y, _n.z);
        P.c.push3(_c.r, _c.g, _c.b);
      }
    };
    for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
      const a0 = ang(i), a1 = ang(i + 1), am = (a0 + a1) / 2;
      const x0 = Math.cos(a0) * radius, z0 = Math.sin(a0) * radius;
      const x1 = Math.cos(a1) * radius, z1 = Math.sin(a1) * radius;
      const nx = Math.cos(am), nz = Math.sin(am);
      emit([[x0, -h, z0], [x1, h, z1], [x1, -h, z1]], nx, 0, nz);
      emit([[x0, -h, z0], [x0, h, z0], [x1, h, z1]], nx, 0, nz);
      emit([[0, h, 0], [x1, h, z1], [x0, h, z0]], 0, 1, 0);
      emit([[0, -h, 0], [x0, -h, z0], [x1, -h, z1]], 0, -1, 0);
    }
    this.count++;
  }

  build(): [MatKey, BufferGeometry][] {
    return [...this.parts.entries()].map(([k, part]) => {
      const g = new BufferGeometry();
      g.setAttribute("position", new BufferAttribute(part.p.out(), 3));
      g.setAttribute("normal", new BufferAttribute(part.n.out(), 3));
      g.setAttribute("color", new BufferAttribute(part.c.out(), 3));
      g.computeBoundingSphere();
      g.computeBoundingBox();
      return [k, g];
    });
  }
}

==== 5022 src/kits/voxelverse/world/Atmosphere.tsx
// Overcast dusk: a sky dome with slow cloud banks, an image-based environment (sky plus warm and cool
// light boxes) so wet and glossy voxels have something to reflect, a cool key light with soft shadows,
// a hemisphere fill and exponential fog. Everything is driven by props: no film-specific state.

import React, { useLayoutEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import { useThree } from "@react-three/fiber";
import { BackSide, BoxGeometry, Color, FogExp2, Mesh, MeshBasicMaterial, PMREMGenerator, Scene, ShaderMaterial, SphereGeometry } from "three";
import { C } from "../lib/palette";
import type { V3 } from "../lib/voxel";

export type SkyLook = { top: number; mid: number; low: number };
export const DUSK: SkyLook = { top: C.hazeTop, mid: C.haze, low: C.horizon };

const skyMaterial = (look: SkyLook) =>
  new ShaderMaterial({
    uniforms: {
      uTop: { value: new Color(look.top) },
      uMid: { value: new Color(look.mid) },
      uLow: { value: new Color(look.low) },
      uBoost: { value: 1 },
    },
    vertexShader: /* glsl */ `varying vec3 vDir; void main(){ vDir = normalize(position); gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
    fragmentShader: /* glsl */ `
      uniform vec3 uTop; uniform vec3 uMid; uniform vec3 uLow; uniform float uBoost; varying vec3 vDir;
      float h(vec2 p){ return fract(sin(dot(p, vec2(41.3, 289.1))) * 43758.5453); }
      float n(vec2 p){ vec2 i=floor(p), f=fract(p); f=f*f*(3.0-2.0*f);
        return mix(mix(h(i),h(i+vec2(1,0)),f.x), mix(h(i+vec2(0,1)),h(i+vec2(1,1)),f.x), f.y); }
      void main(){
        float y = vDir.y;
        vec3 c = mix(uMid, uTop, smoothstep(0.05, 0.6, y));
        c = mix(uLow, c, smoothstep(-0.12, 0.16, y));
        c = mix(vec3(0.016, 0.026, 0.027), c, smoothstep(-0.55, -0.04, y));
        float az = atan(vDir.z, vDir.x);
        float cl = n(vec2(az * 3.0, y * 9.0)) * 0.6 + n(vec2(az * 7.0, y * 21.0)) * 0.4;
        c *= 0.9 + 0.16 * cl * smoothstep(0.0, 0.35, y);
        gl_FragColor = vec4(c * uBoost, 1.0);
      }`,
    side: BackSide,
    depthWrite: false,
    fog: false,
  });

/** Sky dome. `boost` < 1 deepens the dusk (e.g. as windows light up). */
export const Sky: React.FC<{ look?: SkyLook; boost?: number; radius?: number }> = ({ look = DUSK, boost = 1, radius = 420 }) => {
  const mat = useMemo(() => skyMaterial(look), [look]);
  mat.uniforms.uBoost.value = boost;
  return (
    <mesh material={mat} renderOrder={-10} frustumCulled={false}>
      <sphereGeometry args={[radius, 48, 24]} />
    </mesh>
  );
};

/** Reflection environment: the sky plus a ring of warm (and a few cool) light boxes at street level. */
export const Environment: React.FC<{ look?: SkyLook; intensity?: number }> = ({ look = DUSK, intensity = 0.42 }) => {
  const { gl, scene } = useThree();
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const env = new Scene();
    env.add(new Mesh(new SphereGeometry(50, 32, 16), skyMaterial(look)));
    const warm = new MeshBasicMaterial({ color: new Color(C.lampWarm).multiplyScalar(2.2) });
    const cool = new MeshBasicMaterial({ color: new Color(C.tealSoft).multiplyScalar(0.8) });
    for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
      const a = (i / 18) * Math.PI * 2;
      const m = new Mesh(new BoxGeometry(2.5, 1.4 + (i % 3) * 0.6, 0.2), i % 4 === 0 ? cool : warm);
      m.position.set(Math.cos(a) * 30, 3 + (i % 3) * 2, Math.sin(a) * 30);
      m.lookAt(0, 3, 0);
      env.add(m);
    }
    const pm = new PMREMGenerator(gl);
    const rt = pm.fromScene(env, 0.035);
    scene.environment = rt.texture;
    scene.environmentIntensity = intensity;
    return () => {
      scene.environment = null;
      rt.dispose();
      pm.dispose();
    };
  }, [gl, scene, look, intensity]);
  return null;
};

/** Exponential fog; set the density per shot (≈0.012–0.02 at street level, ≈0.002 for a wide). */
export const Fog: React.FC<{ density: number; color?: number }> = ({ density, color = C.haze }) => {
  const { scene } = useThree();
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!(scene.fog instanceof FogExp2)) scene.fog = new FogExp2(new Color(color), density);
    (scene.fog as FogExp2).color.set(color);
    (scene.fog as FogExp2).density = density;
  }, [scene, density, color]);
  return null;
};

/** Cool dusk key with soft shadows over a `size`-metre area, plus hemisphere fill. */
export const DuskLight: React.FC<{ from?: V3; intensity?: number; size?: number; fill?: number }> = ({ from = [-16, 30, 26], intensity = 1.15, size = 30, fill = 0.55 }) => (
  <group>
    <hemisphereLight args={[0xa9c2c0, 0x5a473a, fill]} />
    <directionalLight
      position={from}
      intensity={intensity}
      color={0xc4d8d6}
      castShadow
      shadow-mapSize={[4096, 4096]}
      shadow-bias={-0.0003}
      shadow-normalBias={0.03}
      shadow-camera-left={-size}
      shadow-camera-right={size}
      shadow-camera-top={size}
      shadow-camera-bottom={-size}
      shadow-camera-near={1}
      shadow-camera-far={Math.hypot(...from) + size * 2}
    />
  </group>
);

==== 19768 src/kits/voxelverse/world/Building.tsx
// Spec-driven voxel buildings: proportions, wall type, window rhythm, roof, shopfront and extras are
// data; the model is assembled from the voxel kit (brick or stone walls with cut openings, framed windows,
// sills, arches, shutters, balconies, fire escapes, roofs of five kinds, tanks, chimneys, a clock tower).
// Windows become instanced glow panes whose light is a pure function of the frame.

import React, { useMemo } from "react";
import { C } from "../lib/palette";
import { VoxModel, GlowPanes, type Pane } from "../lib/components";
import { brickWall, sill, shrub, slabWithHoles, windowFrame, downpipe, type Hole } from "../lib/kit";
import type { Vox, V3 } from "../lib/voxel";
import { interiorAtlas } from "../lib/textures";
import { hash } from "../core/noise";

export type WinStyle = "tall" | "square" | "arched" | "pair" | "band" | "round";
export type Roof = "flat" | "gable" | "saw" | "mansard" | "stepped";
export type Shop = "none" | "workshop" | "bakery" | "cinema" | "market" | "arcade" | "depot";

export type BuildingSpec = {
  /** façade width (x) and depth behind the façade (−z) */
  w: number;
  depth: number;
  /** ground-floor height and upper floor heights */
  ground: number;
  floors: number[];
  wall: "brick" | "plaster" | "stone";
  wallColor: number;
  trim: number;
  win: WinStyle;
  bays: number;
  winW: number;
  winH: number;
  roof: Roof;
  roofColor: number;
  shop: Shop;
  shopColor?: number;
  extras?: ("balconies" | "fireEscape" | "shutters" | "ac" | "tank" | "plants" | "awning" | "vent" | "chimney" | "tower")[];
  seed: number;
};

/** Where a building stands: façade centre on the ground, and its turn about Y (0 = façade faces +Z). */
export type Placement = { pos: V3; rotY: number };

export const buildingHeight = (b: BuildingSpec) => b.ground + b.floors.reduce((a, c) => a + c, 0);

/** Voxel model of a building, authored with its façade on z = 0 facing +Z, centred on x = 0. */
export const buildingModel = (b: BuildingSpec) => (v: Vox) => {
  const W = b.w;
  const hw = W / 2;
  const H = b.ground + b.floors.reduce((a, c) => a + c, 0);
  const D = b.depth;
  const has = (e: NonNullable<BuildingSpec["extras"]>[number]) => b.extras?.includes(e);

  // Back and side walls: simple solids so roofs and silhouettes read from above.
  v.span([-hw, 0, -D], [hw, H, -0.3], b.wallColor, { jitter: 0.02 });

  // Ground floor / shopfront
  const g = b.ground;
  const shopHoles: Hole[] = [];
  if (b.shop === "market") {
    for (let i = 0; i < b.bays; i++) {
      const cx = -hw + (W / b.bays) * (i + 0.5);
      shopHoles.push([cx - 0.85, cx + 0.85, 0, g - 1.0]);
    }
  } else if (b.shop === "depot") {
    shopHoles.push([-hw + 1.0, -hw + 4.2, 0, 3.4]);
  } else if (b.shop !== "none") {
    shopHoles.push([-hw + 0.5, hw - 0.5, 0.6, g - 0.85]);
  }
  if (b.wall === "brick") {
    brickWall(v, -hw, hw, 0, g, shopHoles.map((h) => [h[0], h[1], h[2] === 0.6 ? 0 : h[2], h[3]] as Hole), { back: 0.3 });
  } else {
    // rusticated stone base: chunky blocks
    slabWithHoles(v, -hw, hw, 0, g, -0.3, 0, shopHoles.map((h) => [h[0], h[1], h[2] === 0.6 ? 0 : h[2], h[3]] as Hole), b.wall === "stone" ? b.wallColor : b.trim);
    for (let y = 0.05; y < g - 0.3; y += 0.5) {
      for (let x = -hw; x < hw; x += 0.9) {
        const xa = x + ((y * 2) % 2 ? 0.45 : 0);
        const inHole = shopHoles.some((h) => xa + 0.85 > h[0] && xa < h[1] && y + 0.45 > h[2] && y < h[3]);
        if (inHole) continue;
        v.span([Math.max(-hw, xa + 0.02), y, 0], [Math.min(hw, xa + 0.88), y + 0.45, 0.06], b.wall === "stone" ? b.wallColor : C.stoneLight, { jitter: 0.05, r: 0.03 });
      }
    }
  }
  // Shopfront fittings
  if (b.shop === "bakery" || b.shop === "workshop" || b.shop === "arcade" || b.shop === "cinema") {
    const sc = b.shopColor ?? C.tealDeep;
    v.span([-hw + 0.5, 0, -0.2], [hw - 0.5, 0.6, 0.02], sc, { mat: "satin" });
    v.span([-hw + 0.45, g - 0.85, -0.2], [hw - 0.45, g - 0.15, 0.08], sc, { mat: "satin" }); // fascia
    v.span([-hw + 0.4, g - 0.15, -0.2], [hw - 0.4, g - 0.05, 0.14], b.trim, {});
    const n = Math.max(2, Math.round((W - 1) / 1.6));
    for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
      const x = -hw + 0.5 + ((W - 1) / n) * i;
      v.span([x - 0.05, 0.6, -0.18], [x + 0.05, g - 0.85, -0.04], sc, { mat: "satin" });
    }
    if (b.shop === "workshop") {
      // roll-up door: ribbed shutter half-raised
      for (let y = 1.4; y < g - 0.9; y += 0.12) v.span([-hw + 0.6, y, -0.12], [-hw + 0.6 + W * 0.45, y + 0.09, -0.06], C.stoneLight, { mat: "metal" });
    }
    if (b.shop === "arcade") {
      for (let i = 0; i <= 3; i++) {
        const x = -hw + 0.3 + ((W - 0.6) / 3) * i;
        v.span([x - 0.22, 0, 0], [x + 0.22, g - 0.6, 0.3], b.wallColor, { jitter: 0.03 });
      }
    }
  }
  if (b.shop === "depot") {
    // big timber doors, one ajar
    v.span([-hw + 1.05, 0, -0.25], [-hw + 2.6, 3.35, -0.15], C.woodDark, { jitter: 0.05 });
    v.at([-hw + 4.15, 0, -0.2], [0, -0.5, 0], () => v.span([-1.5, 0, -0.05], [0, 3.35, 0.05], C.wood, { jitter: 0.05 }));
    for (let y = 0.4; y < 3.3; y += 0.7) v.span([-hw + 1.05, y, -0.15], [-hw + 2.6, y + 0.08, -0.1], C.ink, { mat: "metal" });
    v.span([-hw + 0.9, 3.4, 0], [-hw + 4.3, 3.75, 0.12], C.stoneLight, {});
  }
  if (b.shop === "market") {
    for (const h of shopHoles) {
      // arched openings: stepped voxel arch + iron grille
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const t = i / 4;
        const off = 0.85 * (1 - Math.cos((t * Math.PI) / 2));
        v.span([h[0] - 0.05, h[3] - 0.1 + t * 0.6, -0.02], [h[0] + off * 0.6, h[3] + t * 0.6 + 0.06, 0.08], C.stoneLight, {});
        v.span([h[1] - off * 0.6, h[3] - 0.1 + t * 0.6, -0.02], [h[1] + 0.05, h[3] + t * 0.6 + 0.06, 0.08], C.stoneLight, {});
      }
      for (let x = h[0] + 0.2; x < h[1]; x += 0.22) v.span([x - 0.015, 0, -0.1], [x + 0.015, h[3] - 0.1, -0.07], C.ink, { mat: "metal" });
    }
  }
  if (b.shop === "cinema") {
    // marquee canopy projecting over the walk
    v.span([-hw + 0.8, g - 0.95, 0], [hw - 0.8, g - 0.6, 1.7], C.tealDeep, { mat: "satin" });
    v.span([-hw + 0.7, g - 0.62, -0.1], [hw - 0.7, g - 0.55, 1.8], C.copper, { mat: "metal" });
    v.span([-hw + 0.8, g - 1.05, 1.62], [hw - 0.8, g - 0.95, 1.72], C.copperDark, { mat: "metal" });
    // tall vertical sign blade
    v.span([-0.3, g + 0.2, 0], [0.3, g + 5.2, 0.9], C.tealDeep, { mat: "satin" });
    v.span([-0.34, g + 0.15, 0.85], [0.34, g + 5.25, 0.95], C.copper, { mat: "metal" });
  }

  // Upper floors
  let y = g;
  b.floors.forEach((fh, fi) => {
    const holes: Hole[] = [];
    const bayW = W / b.bays;
    for (let i = 0; i < b.bays; i++) {
      const cx = -hw + bayW * (i + 0.5);
      if (b.shop === "cinema" && fi < 2 && Math.abs(cx) < 0.9) continue;
      const y0 = y + (fh - b.winH) * 0.45;
      if (b.win === "pair") {
        holes.push([cx - b.winW / 2, cx - 0.06, y0, y0 + b.winH], [cx + 0.06, cx + b.winW / 2, y0, y0 + b.winH]);
      } else if (b.win === "band") {
        holes.push([cx - bayW / 2 + 0.18, cx + bayW / 2 - 0.18, y0 + 0.2, y0 + b.winH]);
      } else {
        holes.push([cx - b.winW / 2, cx + b.winW / 2, y0, y0 + b.winH]);
      }
    }
    if (b.wall === "brick") brickWall(v, -hw, hw, y, y + fh, holes, { back: 0.3 });
    else {
      slabWithHoles(v, -hw, hw, y, y + fh, -0.3, 0, holes, b.wallColor);
      // string course at each floor line
      v.span([-hw - 0.04, y - 0.08, -0.05], [hw + 0.04, y + 0.08, 0.1], b.trim, { jitter: 0.02 });
    }
    for (const h of holes) {
      const isRound = b.win === "round";
      windowFrame(v, h, { color: b.trim, z: -0.13, mullions: h[1] - h[0] > 1.0 && b.win !== "band" ? [(h[0] + h[1]) / 2] : b.win === "band" ? [h[0] + (h[1] - h[0]) / 3, h[0] + (2 * (h[1] - h[0])) / 3] : [], transom: b.win === "tall" || b.win === "arched" ? h[3] - 0.45 : null });
      if (b.win !== "band") sill(v, h[0], h[1], h[2], b.wall === "brick" ? C.stoneLight : b.trim, 0.16);
      if (b.win === "arched" || isRound) {
        // voxel arch: stepped header over the opening
        const w = h[1] - h[0];
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) v.span([h[0] + (i * w) / 9, h[3] + i * 0.07, -0.02], [h[1] - (i * w) / 9, h[3] + (i + 1) * 0.07, 0.07], b.wall === "brick" ? C.brickDark : b.trim, { jitter: 0.03 });
      } else if (b.wall === "brick") {
        for (let x = h[0] - 0.1; x < h[1] + 0.05; x += 0.15) v.box([x + 0.06, h[3] + 0.17, 0.03], [0.12, 0.32, 0.11], C.brickDark, { jitter: 0.08, r: 0.02 });
      } else {
        v.span([h[0] - 0.1, h[3], -0.02], [h[1] + 0.1, h[3] + 0.16, 0.08], b.trim, {});
      }
      if (has("shutters") && b.win !== "band" && b.win !== "pair") {
        const w2 = (h[1] - h[0]) * 0.5;
        for (const [a, c] of [[h[0] - w2 - 0.04, h[0] - 0.04], [h[1] + 0.04, h[1] + w2 + 0.04]]) {
          v.span([a, h[2], 0.02], [c, h[3], 0.07], b.trim === C.cream ? C.teal : b.trim, { mat: "satin", jitter: 0.04 });
          for (let yy = h[2] + 0.1; yy < h[3] - 0.05; yy += 0.15) v.span([a + 0.03, yy, 0.07], [c - 0.03, yy + 0.05, 0.09], C.tealDeep, { mat: "satin" });
        }
      }
      if (has("plants") && hash(b.seed * 31 + Math.round(h[0] * 10 + y)) < 0.45) {
        v.span([h[0] + 0.05, h[2] + 0.0, 0.05], [h[1] - 0.05, h[2] + 0.18, 0.25], C.wood, { jitter: 0.05 });
        shrub(v, [(h[0] + h[1]) / 2, h[2] + 0.24, 0.15], Math.min(0.3, (h[1] - h[0]) * 0.3), fi);
      }
      if (has("ac") && hash(b.seed * 17 + Math.round(h[0] * 7 + y)) < 0.35) {
        v.span([h[1] - 0.6, h[2] - 0.55, 0.0], [h[1] - 0.05, h[2] - 0.15, 0.32], C.cream, { mat: "satin" });
        for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) v.span([h[1] - 0.55, h[2] - 0.5 + k * 0.08, 0.32], [h[1] - 0.25, h[2] - 0.47 + k * 0.08, 0.33], C.stoneDark, {});
      }
    }
    if (has("balconies") && fi >= 0 && fi < b.floors.length) {
      for (const h of holes.filter((_, i) => i % 2 === 0)) {
        const bx0 = h[0] - 0.25, bx1 = h[1] + 0.25;
        v.span([bx0, h[2] - 0.12, 0], [bx1, h[2], 0.75], C.stoneLight, { mat: "wet" });
        for (let x = bx0 + 0.05; x <= bx1; x += 0.16) v.span([x, h[2], 0.69], [x + 0.03, h[2] + 0.7, 0.72], C.ink, { mat: "metal" });
        v.span([bx0, h[2] + 0.68, 0.67], [bx1, h[2] + 0.74, 0.75], C.ink, { mat: "metal" });
        for (const sx of [bx0, bx1 - 0.03]) for (let z = 0.05; z < 0.7; z += 0.16) v.span([sx, h[2], z], [sx + 0.03, h[2] + 0.7, z + 0.03], C.ink, { mat: "metal" });
        if (hash(b.seed + Math.round(h[0] * 13) + fi) < 0.6) shrub(v, [bx0 + 0.3, h[2] + 0.15, 0.45], 0.28, fi + 1);
      }
    }
    y += fh;
  });

  // Fire escape: landings + zig-zag stairs on the middle bays.
  if (has("fireEscape")) {
    let fy = b.ground;
    b.floors.forEach((fh, i) => {
      const x0 = -hw + W * 0.32, x1 = hw - W * 0.12;
      const ly = fy + 0.05;
      v.span([x0, ly, 0.02], [x1, ly + 0.06, 0.9], C.ink, { mat: "metal" });
      for (let x = x0; x <= x1; x += 0.2) v.span([x, ly + 0.06, 0.86], [x + 0.025, ly + 0.95, 0.89], C.ink, { mat: "metal" });
      v.span([x0, ly + 0.92, 0.84], [x1, ly + 0.97, 0.9], C.ink, { mat: "metal" });
      // stair down to the next landing
      if (i > 0) {
        const steps = 9;
        for (let s = 0; s < steps; s++) {
          const t = s / steps;
          const sx = (i % 2 ? x0 + 0.2 : x1 - 0.8) + (i % 2 ? t : 1 - t) * 0.6 * 1.0;
          v.span([sx, ly - fh * t, 0.12], [sx + 0.22, ly - fh * t + 0.04, 0.78], C.ink, { mat: "metal" });
        }
        v.at([(x0 + x1) / 2 + (i % 2 ? -0.4 : 0.4), ly - fh / 2, 0.8], [0, 0, (i % 2 ? 1 : -1) * Math.atan2(fh, 1.4)], () => v.box([0, 0, 0], [0.05, Math.hypot(fh, 1.4) + 0.1, 0.05], C.ink, { mat: "metal" }));
      }
      fy += fh;
    });
  }

  // Roofs
  const rc = b.roofColor;
  if (b.roof === "flat" || b.roof === "stepped") {
    v.span([-hw - 0.08, H - 0.15, -0.3], [hw + 0.08, H + 0.15, 0.18], b.trim, { mat: "wet" });
    v.span([-hw, H + 0.15, -0.3], [hw, H + 0.6, -0.05], b.wall === "brick" ? b.wallColor : b.trim, { jitter: 0.02 });
    v.span([-hw, H, -D], [hw, H + 0.12, -0.3], rc, { mat: "wet" });
    if (b.roof === "stepped") {
      v.span([-hw + 1, H, -D + 0.5], [hw - 1, H + 1.3, -1.8], b.wallColor, {});
      v.span([-hw + 0.9, H + 1.3, -D + 0.4], [hw - 0.9, H + 1.45, -1.7], b.trim, { mat: "wet" });
      v.span([-hw + 2.2, H + 1.45, -D + 1.6], [hw - 2.2, H + 2.4, -3.2], b.wallColor, {});
      v.span([-hw + 2.1, H + 2.4, -D + 1.5], [hw - 2.1, H + 2.52, -3.1], rc, { mat: "wet" });
    }
  } else if (b.roof === "gable") {
    // stepped voxel gable running along X, tiles in rows
    const steps = 6;
    for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
      const inset = (D / 2) * (i / steps);
      v.span([-hw - 0.15, H + i * 0.42, -D - 0.15 + inset], [hw + 0.15, H + (i + 1) * 0.42, 0.15 - inset], i % 2 ? rc : rc, { mat: "wet", jitter: 0.04, r: 0.04 });
    }
    v.span([-hw - 0.2, H + steps * 0.42, -D / 2 - 0.25], [hw + 0.2, H + steps * 0.42 + 0.12, -D / 2 + 0.25], b.trim, { mat: "metal" });
  } else if (b.roof === "mansard") {
    v.span([-hw - 0.1, H - 0.1, -0.3], [hw + 0.1, H + 0.12, 0.2], b.trim, { mat: "wet" });
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) v.span([-hw + i * 0.12, H + 0.12 + i * 0.55, -D + i * 0.15], [hw - i * 0.12, H + 0.12 + (i + 1) * 0.55, -0.1 - i * 0.28], rc, { mat: "wet", jitter: 0.03, r: 0.03 });
    // dormers
    const n = Math.max(1, b.bays - 1);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const cx = -hw + (W / n) * (i + 0.5);
      v.span([cx - 0.45, H + 0.4, -0.95], [cx + 0.45, H + 1.5, -0.25], b.trim, {});
      v.span([cx - 0.55, H + 1.5, -1.0], [cx + 0.55, H + 1.65, -0.15], rc, { mat: "wet" });
    }
  } else if (b.roof === "saw") {
    v.span([-hw, H, -D], [hw, H + 0.12, -0.2], C.stoneDark, {});
    const n = 4;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const z0 = -D + (D / n) * i + 0.1, z1 = z0 + D / n - 0.1;
      for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
        const t = k / 5;
        v.span([-hw + 0.1, H + 0.12 + t * 1.6, z0 + (z1 - z0) * t], [hw - 0.1, H + 0.12 + (t + 0.2) * 1.6, z1], rc, { mat: "wet", r: 0.03, jitter: 0.03 });
      }
      v.span([-hw + 0.2, H + 0.2, z0 - 0.04], [hw - 0.2, H + 1.7, z0 + 0.04], C.tealDeep, { mat: "gloss" });
    }
    v.span([-hw - 0.1, H - 0.2, -0.3], [hw + 0.1, H + 0.6, 0.12], b.wallColor, { jitter: 0.03 });
  }
  if (has("tank")) {
    v.at([hw - 1.6, H + 0.12, -D + 2.2], 0.2, () => {
      for (const [lx, lz] of [[-0.5, -0.5], [0.5, -0.5], [-0.5, 0.5], [0.5, 0.5]]) v.span([lx - 0.06, 0, lz - 0.06], [lx + 0.06, 0.9, lz + 0.06], C.woodDark, {});
      v.prism([0, 1.6, 0], 0.75, 1.3, C.wood, { sides: 12, jitter: 0.03 });
      v.prism([0, 2.4, 0], 0.4, 0.3, C.copperDark, { sides: 12, mat: "metal" });
    });
  }
  if (has("chimney")) {
    for (const cx of [-hw + 0.9, hw - 1.3]) {
      v.span([cx - 0.3, H, -D * 0.6], [cx + 0.3, H + 2.8, -D * 0.6 + 0.6], b.wall === "brick" ? C.brickDark : C.stoneDark, { jitter: 0.04 });
      v.span([cx - 0.36, H + 2.8, -D * 0.6 - 0.06], [cx + 0.36, H + 2.95, -D * 0.6 + 0.66], C.stoneLight, {});
      v.prism([cx, H + 3.1, -D * 0.6 + 0.3], 0.1, 0.3, C.copperDark, { sides: 8, mat: "metal" });
    }
  }
  if (has("vent")) {
    v.span([-0.8, H + 0.12, -D + 1.5], [0.8, H + 0.9, -D + 3.1], C.stoneLight, { mat: "metal" });
  }
  if (has("tower")) {
    // clock tower rising from the east end
    const tx = hw - 2.2, tz = -3.2;
    v.span([tx - 1.6, H, tz - 1.6], [tx + 1.6, H + 8.5, tz + 1.6], b.wallColor, { jitter: 0.02 });
    for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) v.span([tx - 1.7, H + 1.5 + k * 2, tz - 1.7], [tx + 1.7, H + 1.62 + k * 2, tz + 1.7], b.trim, { mat: "metal" });
    v.span([tx - 1.85, H + 8.5, tz - 1.85], [tx + 1.85, H + 8.8, tz + 1.85], C.stoneLight, { mat: "wet" });
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) v.span([tx - 1.4 + i * 0.28, H + 8.8 + i * 0.5, tz - 1.4 + i * 0.28], [tx + 1.4 - i * 0.28, H + 9.3 + i * 0.5, tz + 1.4 - i * 0.28], C.copperPatina, { mat: "metal", r: 0.03 });
    v.span([tx - 0.05, H + 11.2, tz - 0.05], [tx + 0.05, H + 12.6, tz + 0.05], C.copperDark, { mat: "metal" });
    // clock face surrounds (the faces themselves glow)
    v.span([tx - 1.05, H + 5.2, tz + 1.6], [tx + 1.05, H + 7.3, tz + 1.72], C.copperDark, { mat: "metal" });
    v.span([tx - 1.72, H + 5.2, tz - 1.05], [tx - 1.6, H + 7.3, tz + 1.05], C.copperDark, { mat: "metal" });
  }
  // a downpipe on every other building
  if (hash(b.seed) < 0.6) downpipe(v, [hw - 0.2, 0.12], H - 0.1, 0);
};

/** What a pane needs to decide its light: world position, floor (−1 = shop), a stable seed. */
export type PaneInfo = { pos: V3; floor: number; seed: number; shop: boolean };
/** Returns the pane's emission (0 = dark, ~1 = lit) as a function of the film frame. */
export type GlowFn = (p: PaneInfo) => (f: number) => number;

const toWorld = (at: Placement, p: V3): V3 => {
  const c = Math.cos(at.rotY), s = Math.sin(at.rotY);
  return [at.pos[0] + p[0] * c + p[2] * s, at.pos[1] + p[1], at.pos[2] - p[0] * s + p[2] * c];
};

/** Glow panes for a building's windows and shopfront, in world space. */
export const buildingPanes = (b: BuildingSpec, at: Placement, glow: GlowFn): Pane[] => {
  const W = b.w;
  const hw = W / 2;
  const out: Pane[] = [];
  const warmth = [0xffc287, 0xffb070, 0xffd3a4, 0xffa860, 0xf6d9b0];
  let y = b.ground;
  let n = 0;
  b.floors.forEach((fh, fi) => {
    const bayW = W / b.bays;
    for (let i = 0; i < b.bays; i++) {
      const cx = -hw + bayW * (i + 0.5);
      if (b.shop === "cinema" && fi < 2 && Math.abs(cx) < 0.9) continue;
      const y0 = y + (fh - b.winH) * 0.45;
      const rects: [number, number, number, number][] =
        b.win === "pair"
          ? [[cx - b.winW / 2, cx - 0.06, y0, y0 + b.winH], [cx + 0.06, cx + b.winW / 2, y0, y0 + b.winH]]
          : b.win === "band"
            ? [[cx - bayW / 2 + 0.18, cx + bayW / 2 - 0.18, y0 + 0.2, y0 + b.winH]]
            : [[cx - b.winW / 2, cx + b.winW / 2, y0, y0 + b.winH]];
      for (const r of rects) {
        const seed = b.seed * 100 + n++;
        const pos = toWorld(at, [(r[0] + r[1]) / 2, (r[2] + r[3]) / 2, -0.17]);
        out.push({
          pos,
          size: [r[1] - r[0] - 0.08, r[3] - r[2] - 0.08],
          rotY: at.rotY,
          tint: warmth[Math.floor(hash(seed * 11) * warmth.length)],
          cell: Math.floor(hash(seed * 13) * 4) as 0 | 1 | 2 | 3,
          glow: glow({ pos, floor: fi, seed, shop: false }),
        });
      }
    }
    y += fh;
  });
  if (b.shop !== "none" && b.shop !== "market" && b.shop !== "depot") {
    const seed = b.seed * 100 + 99;
    const pos = toWorld(at, [0, (0.6 + b.ground - 0.85) / 2, -0.22]);
    const g = glow({ pos, floor: -1, seed, shop: true });
    out.push({ pos, size: [W - 1.2, b.ground - 0.85 - 0.6 - 0.05], rotY: at.rotY, tint: 0xffc890, cell: 3, glow: (f) => 1.3 * g(f) });
  }
  if (b.shop === "market" || b.shop === "depot") {
    const seed = b.seed * 100 + 98;
    const pos = toWorld(at, [0, b.ground * 0.4, -1.2]);
    const g = glow({ pos, floor: -1, seed, shop: true });
    out.push({ pos, size: [W - 1.0, b.ground * 0.8], rotY: at.rotY, tint: 0xffb878, cell: 0, glow: (f) => 0.9 * g(f) });
  }
  return out;
};

/** A row of buildings with all their glow panes in one instanced draw call. */
export const Buildings: React.FC<{ list: { spec: BuildingSpec; at: Placement }[]; glow: GlowFn; f?: number }> = ({ list, glow, f }) => {
  const panes = useMemo(() => list.flatMap(({ spec, at }) => buildingPanes(spec, at, glow)), [list, glow]);
  const atlas = useMemo(interiorAtlas, []);
  return (
    <group>
      {list.map(({ spec, at }, i) => (
        <group key={i} position={at.pos} rotation={[0, at.rotY, 0]}>
          <VoxModel build={buildingModel(spec)} seed={spec.seed} />
        </group>
      ))}
      <GlowPanes panes={panes} atlas={atlas} f={f} />
    </group>
  );
};

==== 5609 src/kits/voxelverse/world/Plinth.tsx
// The diorama plinth: a street along X (asphalt in patched strips, worn lane marks, an optional zebra
// crossing and tram setts), kerbs and stone-paver walks on both sides, yards behind, puddles, and a
// cut-away base showing soil strata with pebbles and cable ducts, framed in timber. Parametric: one call
// per world. Street centre is z = 0; the plinth top is y = 0 (walks sit at `curb`).

import React from "react";
import { C } from "../lib/palette";
import { VoxModel } from "../lib/components";
import type { Vox } from "../lib/voxel";

export type PlinthSpec = {
  minX: number;
  maxX: number;
  minZ: number;
  maxZ: number;
  /** half width of the carriageway */
  roadHalf: number;
  /** kerb height */
  curb: number;
  /** outer edge of each walk, measured from the street centre */
  walkOuter: number;
  /** depth of the cut-away base below the street */
  baseDepth: number;
  /** x of a zebra crossing, if any */
  crossingX?: number;
  /** tram setts and rails down the middle */
  tram?: boolean;
  /** puddles: [x, z, width, depth] */
  puddles?: [number, number, number, number][];
};

const ground = (P: PlinthSpec) => (v: Vox) => {
  const { minX, maxX, minZ, maxZ, roadHalf, curb, walkOuter, baseDepth } = P;
  // road: slightly crowned asphalt in long strips with patched sections
  for (let x = minX; x < maxX - 0.01; x += 2)
    for (let z = -roadHalf; z < roadHalf - 0.01; z += 1.6) {
      const patch = v.rand() < 0.12;
      const crown = 0.02 * (1 - Math.abs(z) / roadHalf);
      v.span([x, -0.2, z], [Math.min(x + 2, maxX), crown, Math.min(z + 1.6, roadHalf)], patch ? 0x474b4a : C.asphalt, { mat: "wet", r: 0.005, jitter: 0.05 });
    }
  if (P.tram) {
    for (let x = minX; x < maxX - 0.01; x += 0.3)
      for (let z = -0.9; z < 0.9; z += 0.3) v.span([x + 0.01, 0.0, z + 0.01], [x + 0.29, 0.035, z + 0.29], C.cobble, { mat: "wet", r: 0.02, jitter: 0.12 });
    for (const rz of [-0.72, 0.72]) v.span([minX, 0.035, rz - 0.04], [maxX, 0.07, rz + 0.04], C.stoneLight, { mat: "metal", r: 0.01 });
  } else {
    // worn centre line
    for (let x = minX + 0.6; x < maxX - 1; x += 2.6) v.span([x, 0.02, -0.05], [x + 1.3, 0.03, 0.05], 0xbfb6a0, { mat: "wet", r: 0.004 });
  }
  if (P.crossingX !== undefined)
    for (let z = -roadHalf + 0.3; z < roadHalf - 0.3; z += 0.55)
      v.span([P.crossingX - 0.9, 0.02, z], [P.crossingX + 0.9, 0.035, z + 0.32], 0xd5ccb6, { mat: "wet", r: 0.004, jitter: 0.04 });
  // kerbs and square stone pavers, both sides
  for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
    v.span([minX, -0.2, s > 0 ? roadHalf - 0.1 : -roadHalf - 0.12], [maxX, curb, s > 0 ? roadHalf + 0.12 : -roadHalf + 0.1], C.stoneLight, { mat: "wet", r: 0.02 });
    const z0 = s > 0 ? roadHalf + 0.12 : -walkOuter;
    const z1 = s > 0 ? walkOuter : -roadHalf - 0.12;
    for (let x = minX; x < maxX - 0.01; x += 0.62)
      for (let z = z0; z < z1 - 0.01; z += 0.62)
        v.span([x + 0.015, curb - 0.2, z + 0.015], [Math.min(x + 0.605, maxX), curb, Math.min(z + 0.605, z1)], v.rand() < 0.15 ? C.stoneDark : C.stone, { mat: "wet", r: 0.015, jitter: 0.07 });
    for (let x = minX + 2.5; x < maxX - 1; x += 6.3) v.span([x, 0.0, s * (roadHalf - 0.42)], [x + 0.6, 0.012, s * (roadHalf - 0.08)], C.ink, { mat: "metal" });
    // yards behind the walks so the plinth top is never empty
    const zA = s > 0 ? walkOuter : minZ;
    const zB = s > 0 ? maxZ : -walkOuter;
    if (zB > zA) v.span([minX, -0.2, zA], [maxX, 0.05, zB], C.cobble, { mat: "wet", jitter: 0.03, r: 0.01 });
  }
  // cut-away base: strata, pebbles on the faces, cable ducts, timber edge frame
  const cuts = [...[-0.2, -0.7, -1.6, -2.7].filter((y) => y > -baseDepth + 0.05), -baseDepth];
  const sc = [C.stoneDark, 0x6b5543, 0x5a4636, 0x4b3a2e];
  for (let i = 0; i < cuts.length - 1; i++) v.span([minX, cuts[i + 1], minZ], [maxX, cuts[i], maxZ], sc[Math.min(i, sc.length - 1)], { r: 0.02 });
  const pebbles = Math.round(((maxX - minX) + (maxZ - minZ)) * 5);
  for (let i = 0; i < pebbles; i++) {
    const onFront = v.rand() < 0.6;
    const y = -0.8 - v.rand() * (baseDepth - 1.0);
    const s = 0.08 + v.rand() * 0.16;
    const col = [0x7a6656, 0x8b7a68, 0x5c4a3c][Math.floor(v.rand() * 3)];
    if (onFront) v.box([minX + 0.5 + v.rand() * (maxX - minX - 1), y, maxZ + 0.02], [s, s * 0.7, 0.06], col, { jitter: 0.1 });
    else v.box([minX - 0.02, y, minZ + 0.5 + v.rand() * (maxZ - minZ - 1)], [0.06, s * 0.7, s], col, { jitter: 0.1 });
  }
  for (const [z, y] of [[-roadHalf * 0.5, -1.15], [roadHalf * 0.4, -1.3]] as const)
    v.span([minX - 0.05, y - 0.22, z - 0.22], [maxX + 0.05, y + 0.22, z + 0.22], 0x3b3633, { r: 0.04 });
  v.span([minX - 0.18, -0.25, maxZ], [maxX + 0.18, 0.08, maxZ + 0.18], C.woodDark, { r: 0.02 });
  v.span([minX - 0.18, -0.25, minZ - 0.18], [maxX + 0.18, 0.08, minZ], C.woodDark, { r: 0.02 });
  v.span([minX - 0.18, -0.25, minZ], [minX, 0.08, maxZ], C.woodDark, { r: 0.02 });
  v.span([maxX, -0.25, minZ], [maxX + 0.18, 0.08, maxZ], C.woodDark, { r: 0.02 });
};

/** Mirror-calm puddles: low-roughness plates just above the road or walk. */
const puddles = (P: PlinthSpec) => (v: Vox) => {
  for (const [x, z, w, d] of P.puddles ?? []) {
    const y = Math.abs(z) > P.roadHalf ? P.curb + 0.004 : 0.03;
    v.span([x - w / 2, y - 0.01, z - d / 2], [x + w / 2, y, z + d / 2], 0x262b2b, { mat: "gloss", r: 0.003 });
  }
};

export const Plinth: React.FC<{ spec: PlinthSpec }> = ({ spec }) => (
  <group>
    <VoxModel build={ground(spec)} seed={21} castShadow={false} />
    {spec.puddles?.length ? <VoxModel build={puddles(spec)} seed={22} castShadow={false} /> : null}
  </group>
);

==== 5804 src/kits/voxelverse/world/Rain.tsx
// Rain. A dense volume of streaks anchored in world space but wrapped around the lens (so it never swims
// with the camera), ripples on the wet ground near the camera, and an optional sparse diorama-wide volume
// for wide shots. `blocked(x, y, z)` keeps drops out of interiors and from under awnings; `groundY(x, z)`
// tells ripples where the surface is. All motion is a pure function of the film frame (60 fps clock).

import React, { useLayoutEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import { AdditiveBlending, BoxGeometry, Color, Euler, InstancedMesh, Matrix4, MeshBasicMaterial, Quaternion, RingGeometry, Vector3 } from "three";
import { rng } from "../core/noise";
import { clamp } from "../core/motion";
import { FX_LAYER } from "../lib/layers";
import type { CamState } from "../camera/rig";

const wrap = (v: number, lo: number, size: number) => lo + ((((v - lo) % size) + size) % size);

export type RainProps = {
  cam: CamState;
  /** film frame, 60 fps clock */
  f: number;
  /** 0..1 strength of the near volume */
  amount?: number;
  /** 0..1 strength of the diorama-wide volume (wide shots) */
  wide?: number;
  /** world area for the wide volume */
  bounds?: { minX: number; maxX: number; minZ: number; maxZ: number; height: number };
  blocked?: (x: number, y: number, z: number) => boolean;
  groundY?: (x: number, z: number) => number;
  near?: number;
  far?: number;
  ripples?: number;
};

const BOX: [number, number, number] = [16, 11, 16];
const FALL = 9.5; // units per second
const WIND = 0.12; // slant

export const Rain: React.FC<RainProps> = ({ cam, f, amount = 1, wide = 0, bounds, blocked = () => false, groundY = () => 0.035, near = 2600, far = 3000, ripples = 260 }) => {
  const sys = useMemo(() => {
    const r = rng(77);
    const nearD = Array.from({ length: near }, () => [r(), r(), r(), 0.6 + r() * 0.8] as const);
    const farD = Array.from({ length: far }, () => [r(), r(), r(), 0.75 + r() * 0.5] as const);
    const rip = Array.from({ length: ripples }, () => [r(), r(), Math.floor(r() * 30)] as const);
    const mat = new MeshBasicMaterial({ color: new Color(0.42, 0.47, 0.48), transparent: true, opacity: 0.26, blending: AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false, fog: false });
    const nearMesh = new InstancedMesh(new BoxGeometry(0.0045, 0.26, 0.0045), mat, near);
    const farMat = mat.clone();
    const farMesh = new InstancedMesh(new BoxGeometry(0.035, 0.9, 0.035), farMat, far);
    const ripMat = new MeshBasicMaterial({ color: new Color(1, 1, 1), transparent: true, blending: AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false, fog: false });
    const ripMesh = new InstancedMesh(new RingGeometry(0.8, 1, 20).rotateX(-Math.PI / 2), ripMat, ripples);
    for (const m of [nearMesh, farMesh, ripMesh]) {
      m.frustumCulled = false;
      m.layers.set(FX_LAYER);
    }
    return { nearD, farD, rip, nearMesh, farMesh, ripMesh, mat, farMat };
  }, [near, far, ripples]);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const t = f / 60;
    const m = new Matrix4();
    const q = new Quaternion().setFromEuler(new Euler(0, 0, WIND));
    const s = new Vector3(1, 1, 1);
    const p = new Vector3();
    sys.mat.opacity = 0.26 * amount;
    const lo = [cam.pos[0] - BOX[0] / 2, cam.pos[1] - BOX[1] * 0.55, cam.pos[2] - BOX[2] / 2];
    sys.nearD.forEach(([a, b, c, sp], i) => {
      const y = wrap(b * BOX[1] - t * FALL * sp, lo[1], BOX[1]);
      const x = wrap(a * BOX[0] + y * WIND, lo[0], BOX[0]);
      const z = wrap(c * BOX[2], lo[2], BOX[2]);
      const tooClose = Math.hypot(x - cam.pos[0], y - cam.pos[1], z - cam.pos[2]) < 0.7;
      const hidden = amount <= 0 || tooClose || y < groundY(x, z) || blocked(x, y, z);
      s.set(hidden ? 0 : 1, hidden ? 0 : sp, hidden ? 0 : 1);
      m.compose(p.set(x, y, z), q, s);
      sys.nearMesh.setMatrixAt(i, m);
    });
    sys.nearMesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;

    sys.farMat.opacity = 0.16 * wide;
    sys.farD.forEach(([a, b, c, sp], i) => {
      let hidden = wide <= 0 || !bounds;
      let x = 0, y = 0, z = 0;
      if (bounds) {
        y = wrap(b * bounds.height - t * FALL * 1.3 * sp, 0, bounds.height);
        x = bounds.minX + a * (bounds.maxX - bounds.minX);
        z = bounds.minZ + c * (bounds.maxZ - bounds.minZ);
        hidden = hidden || Math.hypot(x - cam.pos[0], y - cam.pos[1], z - cam.pos[2]) < 9 || blocked(x, y, z);
      }
      s.set(hidden ? 0 : 1, hidden ? 0 : sp, hidden ? 0 : 1);
      m.compose(p.set(x, y, z), q, s);
      sys.farMesh.setMatrixAt(i, m);
    });
    sys.farMesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;

    // ripples: each spot re-fires on its own 30-frame cycle, near the camera only
    const col = new Color();
    const closeness = clamp(1 - (cam.pos[1] - 1) / 12) * amount;
    const F = Math.floor(f);
    sys.rip.forEach(([a, c, phase], i) => {
      const cyc = (F + phase) % 30;
      const gen = Math.floor((F + phase) / 30);
      const r = rng(i * 131 + gen * 7);
      const x = cam.pos[0] - 6 + ((a * 12 + r() * 3) % 12);
      const z = cam.pos[2] - 6 + ((c * 12 + r() * 3) % 12);
      const y = groundY(x, z) + 0.006;
      const k = cyc / 30;
      const rad = 0.02 + k * 0.09;
      const hidden = closeness <= 0 || blocked(x, y + 0.5, z);
      s.set(hidden ? 0 : rad, 1, hidden ? 0 : rad);
      m.compose(p.set(x, y, z), new Quaternion(), s);
      sys.ripMesh.setMatrixAt(i, m);
      col.setScalar((1 - k) * (1 - k) * 0.13 * closeness);
      sys.ripMesh.setColorAt(i, col);
    });
    sys.ripMesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
    if (sys.ripMesh.instanceColor) sys.ripMesh.instanceColor.needsUpdate = true;
  }, [f, sys, cam, amount, wide, bounds, blocked, groundY]);

  return (
    <group>
      <primitive object={sys.nearMesh} />
      <primitive object={sys.farMesh} />
      <primitive object={sys.ripMesh} />
    </group>
  );
};
